1920 Ganja revolt.headline: Upor v Gandži leta 1920
paragraphs: Upor v Gandži leta 1920 (azerbajdžansko: Gəncə üsyanı) je bil ljudska vstaja proti sovjetski okupaciji, ki je v Gandži potekala od 26. do 31. maja 1920. Cilj vstaje je bil strmoglaviti sovjetsko oblast v Azerbajdžanu. To je bil največji upor proti sovjetski oblasti v Azerbajdžanu v 20. stoletju in je terjal največ žrtev. Organizatorji in vodilna sila vstaje so bili častniki vojske nekdanje Azerbajdžanske demokratične republike.

source.title: 1920 Ganja revolt
paragraphs: The 1920 Ganja revolt (Azerbaijani: Gəncə üsyanı) was a popular uprising against the Soviet occupation that took place in Ganja on 26 to 31 May 1920. The goal of the uprising was to overthrow the Soviet government in Azerbaijan. This was the largest rebellion against Soviet rule in Azerbaijan in the 20th century, and caused the most losses. The organizers and leading force of the uprising were officers of the army of the former Azerbaijan Democratic Republic.

1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Gruziji 1991–1992
paragraphs: Državni udar v Gruziji 1991–1992, znan tudi kot tbilisijska vojna ali puč 1991–1992, je bil notranji vojaški spopad v novo neodvisni Republiki Gruziji po razpadu Sovjetske zveze, od 22. decembra 1991 do 6. januarja 1992. V udaru, ki je sprožil gruzijsko državljansko vojno, so se frakcije nacionalne garde, zveste predsedniku Zviadu Gamsahurdiji, spopadle z več paravojaškimi organizacijami, ki so se konec leta 1991 združile pod vodstvom vojskovodij Tengiza Kitovanija, Džabe Ioselianija in Tengiza Sigue.

source.title: 1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1991–1992 Georgian coup d'état, also known as the Tbilisi War, or the Putsch of 1991–1992, was an internal military conflict that took place in the newly independent Republic of Georgia following the fall of the Soviet Union, from 22 December 1991 to 6 January 1992. The coup, which triggered the Georgian Civil War, pitted factions of the National Guard loyal to President Zviad Gamsakhurdia against several paramilitary organizations unified at the end of 1991 under the leadership of warlords Tengiz Kitovani, Jaba Ioseliani and Tengiz Sigua.

1993 Azerbaijani coup d'état.headline: Državni udar v Azerbajdžanu leta 1993
paragraphs: Državni udar v Azerbajdžanu leta 1993, znan tudi kot gandžanska vstaja, je bil vojaški udar pod vodstvom azerbajdžanskega vojaškega poveljnika Surata Husejnova. Husejnove sile so 4. junija 1993 krenile na pohod iz Gandže proti azerbajdžanski prestolnici Baku, da bi strmoglavile predsednika Abulfaza Elčibeja, izvoljenega na prvih svobodnih volitvah v neodvisnem Azerbajdžanu leta 1992.
Udar, ki ga je podpirala Rusija, je odstavil Elčibeja in na predsedniški položaj postavil Hejdarja Alijeva. Kmalu zatem je Rusija začela podpirati poskuse udara proti Alijevu, denimo udar leta 1994.
notes: Izpuščena je oznaka opombe [1].

source.title: 1993 Azerbaijani coup d'état
paragraphs: The 1993 Azeri coup d'état, also known as the Ganja Uprising, was a military coup led by Azerbaijani military commander Surat Huseynov. On June 4, 1993, Huseynov's forces led a march from the city of Ganja to the Azerbaijani capital of Baku in order to overthrow President Abulfaz Elchibey who was elected in independent Azerbaijan's first free election in 1992.
The Russia-backed coup ousted Elchibey and installed Heydar Aliyev as president. Shortly afterwards, Russia would begin supporting coup attempts against Aliyev, such as the 1994 coup.[1]

1995 Azerbaijani coup attempt.headline: Poskus državnega udara v Azerbajdžanu leta 1995
paragraphs: Poskus državnega udara v Azerbajdžanu leta 1995, znan tudi kot turški udar v Bakuju, so izvedli pripadniki azerbajdžanske vojske pod vodstvom polkovnika Rovšana Džavadova, ki je vodil odred posebne policijske enote (OPON). Skupina je hotela prevzeti oblast od predsednika Hejdarja Alijeva in znova postaviti nekdanjega predsednika Abulfaza Elčibeja. Udar je spodletel, ko je turški predsednik Süleyman Demirel izvedel, da zaroto podpirajo nekateri krogi v Turčiji, in Alijeva po telefonu posvaril. Enote azerbajdžanskih oboroženih sil so 17. marca 1995 obkolile tabor upornikov in ga napadle, pri čemer je bil ubit polkovnik Džavadov. Poročila v Turčiji po aferi Susurluk leta 1996 so podrobneje razkrila, kako so udar podpirali krogi v Turčiji.

source.title: 1995 Azerbaijani coup attempt
paragraphs: The 1995 Azerbaijani coup d'état attempt, also known as the Turkish coup in Baku, was a coup d'état attempt by members of the Azerbaijani military, led by Colonel Rovshan Javadov at the head of a detachment of Special Purpose Police Unit (OPON). The group aimed to take control of the country from president Heydar Aliyev and reinstall former president Abulfaz Elchibey. The coup was foiled when the Turkish President Süleyman Demirel became aware of elements in Turkey supporting the plot, and called Aliyev to warn him. On 17 March 1995, units of the Azerbaijani Armed Forces surrounded the insurgents' camp and assaulted it, killing Colonel Javadov. Reports in Turkey following the 1996 Susurluk scandal elaborated on support for the coup from elements in Turkey.

2010 Kyrgyz Revolution.headline: Kirgiška revolucija leta 2010
paragraphs: Kirgiška revolucija leta 2010, znana tudi kot druga kirgiška revolucija, melonska revolucija, aprilski dogodki ali uradno ljudska aprilska revolucija (kirgiško: Апрель Элдик революциясы), se je začela aprila 2010 z odstavitvijo kirgiškega predsednika Kurmanbeka Bakijeva v prestolnici Biškek. Sledile so ji vse večje etnične napetosti med Kirgizi in Uzbeki na jugu države, ki so junija 2010 prerasle v nasilje. Nasilje je nazadnje privedlo do utrditve novega parlamentarnega sistema v Kirgizistanu.

Izgnanci iz uzbeške manjšine trdijo, da so jih v splošnem kaosu napadali in pregnali v Uzbekistan, okoli 400.000 državljanov Kirgizistana pa je postalo notranje razseljenih. Žrtve, s katerimi so govorili novinarji in humanitarni delavci, pričajo o množičnih pobojih, skupinskih posilstvih in mučenju. Tedanja vodja začasne vlade Roza Otunbajeva je navedla, da je smrtnih žrtev desetkrat več, kot so poročali prej, s čimer se število mrtvih povzpne na 2000.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija kirgiškega imena.

source.title: 2010 Kyrgyz Revolution
paragraphs: The 2010 Kyrgyz Revolution, also known as the Second Kyrgyz Revolution, the Melon Revolution, the April Events, or officially as the People's April Revolution (Kyrgyz: Апрель Элдик революциясы, romanized: Aprel Yeldik revolyutsiyasy), began in April 2010 with the ousting of Kyrgyz president Kurmanbek Bakiyev in the capital Bishkek. It was followed by increased ethnic tension involving Kyrgyz people and Uzbeks in the south of the country, which escalated in June 2010. The violence ultimately led to the consolidation of a new parliamentary system in Kyrgyzstan.

During the general mayhem, exiles from the Uzbek minority claim they were assaulted and driven to Uzbekistan, with some 400,000 Kyrgyzstani citizens becoming internally displaced. Victims interviewed by media and aid workers testify to mass killing, gang rape and torture. Then-head of the Interim government Roza Otunbayeva indicated that the death toll is tenfold higher than was previously reported, which brings the number of the dead to 2,000 people.

2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreemen.headline: Sporazum o premirju v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020
paragraphs: Sporazum o premirju v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020 je bil sporazum o prekinitvi ognja, s katerim se je končala vojna v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020. Podpisali so ga 9. novembra azerbajdžanski predsednik Ilham Alijev, armenski predsednik vlade Nikol Pašinjan in ruski predsednik Vladimir Putin, vse sovražnosti v Gorskem Karabahu pa so se končale 10. novembra 2020 ob 00.00 po moskovskem času. V prekinitev sovražnosti je privolil tudi predsednik odcepljene Republike Arcah Arajik Harutjunjan.
notes: Druga vojna v Gorskem Karabahu je poimenovana po glosarju (Vojna v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020).

source.title: 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement
paragraphs: The 2020 Nagorno-Karabakh ceasefire agreement was an armistice agreement that ended the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War. It was signed on 9 November by the President of Azerbaijan Ilham Aliyev, the Prime Minister of Armenia Nikol Pashinyan and the President of Russia Vladimir Putin, and ended all hostilities in the Nagorno-Karabakh region from 00:00, on 10 November 2020 Moscow time. The president of the breakaway Republic of Artsakh, Arayik Harutyunyan, also agreed to an end of hostilities.

2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes.headline: Spopadi med Kirgizistanom in Tadžikistanom leta 2021
paragraphs: Tridnevni mejni spopad med Kirgizistanom in Tadžikistanom se je začel 28. aprila 2021. Spopadi so izvirali iz dolgotrajnega spora glede vodooskrbnega objekta pri vasi Kök-Taš. Tadžikistanski mediji so pred spopadom izražali zaskrbljenost zaradi vojaških vaj v Batkenu.

source.title: 2021 Kyrgyzstan–Tajikistan clashes
paragraphs: A three-day border conflict between Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan began on 28 April 2021. The clashes stemmed from a long-running dispute over a water supply facility near the village of Kök-Tash. Tajikistani media raised some concern over military drills in Batken prior to the conflict.

Anuštegini ali dinastija Anuštegin (perzijsko: خاندان انوشتکین), znani tudi kot horezmijska dinastija (perzijsko: خوارزمشاهیان), so bili sunitska muslimanska dinastija turškega mameluškega porekla iz klana Bekdili oguških Turkov. Anuštegini so vladali Horezmijskemu cesarstvu, ki je obsegalo velik del današnje Srednje Azije, Afganistana in Irana, približno od leta 1077 do 1231, najprej kot vazali Seldžukov in Kara Kitajev (Zahodnega Ljaa), pozneje pa kot samostojni vladarji, vse do mongolske osvojitve Horezmijskega cesarstva v 13. stoletju.

Dinastijo je ustanovil poveljnik Anuštegin Garčaj, nekdanji turški suženj seldžuških sultanov, ki so ga imenovali za upravitelja Horezma. Njegov sin Kutb ad-Din Mohamed I. je postal prvi dedni horezmijski šah. Anuštegin je morda pripadal plemenu Begdili oguških Turkov ali pa Čigilom, Halajem, Kipčakom, Kanglijem ali Ujgurom.
notes: Izpuščen je prazen oklepaj (»English:«) iz vira.

source.title: Anushtegin dynasty
paragraphs: The Anushtegin dynasty or Anushteginids (English:, Persian: خاندان انوشتکین), also known as the Khwarazmian dynasty (Persian: خوارزمشاهیان) was a Sunni Muslim dynasty of Turkic mamluk origin from the Bekdili clan of the Oghuz Turks. The Anushteginid dynasty ruled the Khwarazmian Empire, consisting in large parts of present-day Central Asia, Afghanistan and Iran in the approximate period of 1077 to 1231, first as vassals of the Seljuks and the Qara Khitai (Western Liao), and later as independent rulers, up until the Mongol conquest of the Khwarazmian Empire in the 13th century.

The dynasty was founded by commander Anushtegin Gharchai, a former Turkic slave of the Seljuq sultans, who was appointed as governor of Khwarazm. His son, Qutb ad-Din Muhammad I, became the first hereditary Shah of Khwarazm. Anush Tigin may have belonged to either the Begdili tribe of the Oghuz Turks or to Chigil, Khalaj, Qipchaq, Qangly, or Uyghurs.

Armenian–Azerbaijani war (1918–1920).headline: Armensko-azerbajdžanska vojna (1918–1920)
paragraphs: Armensko-azerbajdžanska vojna (1918–1920) je bila spopad na južnem Kavkazu na območjih z mešanim armenskim in azerbajdžanskim prebivalstvom, ki v grobem obsegajo današnji Azerbajdžan in Armenijo. Začela se je v zadnjih mesecih prve svetovne vojne in se končala z vzpostavitvijo sovjetske oblasti.

Spopad je potekal v ozadju ruske državljanske vojne in delitve Osmanskega cesarstva. Medsebojne ozemeljske zahteve novoustanovljene Azerbajdžanske demokratične republike in Republike Armenije so privedle do tega, da sta državi podpirali azerbajdžanske oziroma armenske milice na spornih ozemljih. Armenija se je bojevala proti azerbajdžanskim milicam v Erivanski guberniji nekdanjega Ruskega imperija, Azerbajdžan pa se je upiral armenskim zahtevam po Karabahu. Vojno so zaznamovali izbruhi pokolov in etničnega čiščenja (denimo marčni dnevi, septembrski dnevi, pokol v Šuši in širše pokoli Azerbajdžancev v Armeniji), ki so spremenili demografsko sliko regije.

source.title: Armenian–Azerbaijani war (1918–1920)
paragraphs: The Armenian-Azerbaijani war (1918–1920) was a conflict that took place in the South Caucasus in regions with a mixed Armenian-Azerbaijani population, broadly encompassing what are now modern-day Azerbaijan and Armenia. It began during the final months of World War I and ended with the establishment of Soviet rule.

The conflict took place against the backdrop of the Russian Civil War and the partition of the Ottoman Empire. Mutual territorial claims, made by the newly formed Azerbaijan Democratic Republic and the Republic of Armenia, led to their respective support for Azerbaijani and Armenian militias in the disputed territories. Armenia fought against Azerbaijani militias in the Erivan Governorate of the former Russian Empire, while Azerbaijan fought Armenian claims to the Karabakh region. The war was characterized by outbreaks of massacres and ethnic cleansing (such as the March Days, the September Days, the Shusha massacre, and more broadly, the massacres of Azerbaijanis in Armenia), which changed the demographics of the region.

Armeno-Georgian War.headline: Armensko-gruzijska vojna
paragraphs: Armensko-gruzijska vojna je bila kratek mejni spor, ki se je decembra 1918 bil med novo neodvisno Demokratično republiko Gruzijo in Prvo republiko Armenijo, predvsem za nadzor nad nekdanjimi okraji Tifliške gubernije v Borčaliju (Loriju) in Ahalkalakiju.

Maja 1918, proti koncu prve svetovne vojne, sta Armenija in Gruzija razglasili neodvisnost in s tem razpustili kratkotrajno zvezo med njima. Obe sta zahtevali Lori in Ahalkalaki, kjer so živeli pretežno Armenci. Mejni spor je 7. decembra 1918 prerasel v odprt vojaški spopad. Armenske sile so z bliskovitimi napadi prodrle do 10 kilometrov od gruzijske prestolnice Tiflis, preden so gruzijske čete lahko organizirale protinapade. Posredovanje zaveznikov je izsililo premirje. Boji so trajali, dokler premirje ni začelo veljati ob polnoči 31. decembra.

source.title: Armeno-Georgian War
paragraphs: The Armeno-Georgian War was a short border dispute that was fought in December 1918 between the newly independent Democratic Republic of Georgia and the First Republic of Armenia, largely over the control of former districts of the Tiflis Governorate, in Borchaly (Lori) and Akhalkalaki.

In May 1918, towards the end of World War I, Armenia and Georgia both declared their independence, dissolving the short-lived union between them. Both Georgia and Armenia claimed Lori and Akhalkalaki, both of which were populated primarily by Armenians. The border dispute turned into an open military conflict on 7 December 1918. Armenian forces initiated coup de mains that brought them within 10 kilometers of the Georgian capital, Tiflis, before Georgian troops were able to organize counterattacks. Allied intervention forced a ceasefire. Battles continued until the ceasefire came into effect at midnight on December 31.

Balasagan.headline: Balasagan
paragraphs: Balasagan (iranski toponim, ki pomeni »dežela Balasa«; armensko: Bałasakan, prebivalci Bałasičkʻ; arabsko: Balāsajān/Balāšajān), znan tudi kot Bazgan, je bil pokrajina na območju rek Kura in Araks ob Kaspijskem jezeru. Na jugu je mejil na Atropateno oziroma Adurbadagan in Gilan. Približno se je ujemal z armensko provinco Pajtakaran, vendar je segal dlje proti severu. Po nekaterih domnevah se je pod Sasanidi raztezal vse do trdnjave Derbent, kar pa ostaja sporno. Osrčje Balasagana je bila ravnina Dašt i-Bałasakan (»Balasaganska ravnina«), ki ustreza Muganski ravnini. V poznem sasanidskem obdobju je bil Balasagan vključen v severni kvadrant (kust) Adurbadagana.

source.title: Balasagan
paragraphs: Balāsagān (an Iranian toponym meaning "country of Balas"; Armenian: Bałasakan, the inhabitants known as Bałasičkʻ, Arabic: Balāsajān/Balāšajān), also known as Bazgan, was a region located in the area of the Kura and Aras rivers, adjacent to the Caspian Sea. To the south, it bordered Atropatene/Adurbadagan and Gilan. It roughly corresponded to the Armenian province of Paytakaran, albeit extending farther into the north. It has been suggested that under the Sasanians the region extended as far as the stronghold of Derbent, albeit this remains disputed. The heartland of Balasagan was the Dasht i-Bałasakan ("Balasagan plain") which corresponds to the Mughan plain. During the late Sasanian era, Balasagan was included in the northern quadrant (kust) of Adurbadagan.

Basmačijsko gibanje (rusko: Басмачество, iz uzbeškega Босмачи, dobesedno »razbojniki«) je bilo uporniško gibanje proti carski ruski in sovjetski oblasti v Srednji Aziji. Označili so ga za »verjetno najpomembnejše gibanje upora proti sovjetski oblasti v Srednji Aziji«.
notes: Izpuščeni sta latinični transliteraciji ruskega in uzbeškega imena.

source.title: Basmachi movement
paragraphs: The Basmachi movement (Russian: Басмачество, romanized: Basmachestvo, derived from Uzbek: Босмачи, romanized: Bosmachi, lit. 'bandits') was an uprising against Imperial Russian and Soviet rule in Central Asia. It has been called "probably the most important movement of opposition to Soviet rule in Central Asia".

Battle of Abaran.headline: Bitka pri Abaranu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Baš Abaranu (armensko: Բաշ Աբարանի ճակատամարտ; turško: Baş-Abaran Muharebesi) je bila del kavkaške fronte prve svetovne vojne in je potekala leta 1918 v okolici Baš Abarana. Armenske zmage pri Baš Abaranu, Sardarabadu in Karakilisi so ustavile osmansko invazijo na vzhodno Armenijo in odločilno omogočile nastanek kratkotrajne Prve republike Armenije.

Turške sile so napadle 21. maja in prodirale proti Erevanu. Nasproti so jim stale armenske sile pod poveljstvom Drastamata Kanajana. Eden od treh krakov osmanskega napada, 3. polk 11. kavkaške divizije, se je spustil iz Hamamluja. V soteski Baš Abaran, približno tri ure hoda od Erevana, je naletel na armensko enoto s približno 1000 strelci pod poveljstvom Movsesa Silikjana. Po treh dneh hudih bojev so Armenci 25. maja sprožili protinapad proti Turkom. Turške sile so se nato 29. maja umaknile na sever, nazaj v Hamamlu.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija armenskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Abaran
paragraphs: The Battle of Bash Abaran (Armenian: Բաշ Աբարանի ճակատամարտ Bash Abarani chakatamart, Turkish: Baş-Abaran Muharebesi) was part of Caucasus Campaign of World War I that took place in the vicinity of Bash Abaran, in 1918. The Armenian victories at Bash Abaran, Sardarabad and Karakilisa, halted the Ottoman invasion of Eastern Armenia and were instrumental in allowing the formation of the short-lived First Republic of Armenia.

The Turkish forces attacked on 21 May, driving towards Yerevan. They were opposed by Armenian forces under the command of Drastamat Kanayan. One prong of the three-pronged Ottoman attack, consisting of the 3rd Regiment of the 11th Caucasian Division, moved down from Hamamlu. They met an Armenian force of about 1,000 riflemen under the command of Movses Silikyan at the defile of Bash Abaran, about a three-hour march from Yerevan. After three days of fierce fighting the Armenians launched a counter-attack against the Turks on 25 May. The Turkish forces then retreated north back to Hamamlu on 29 May.

Battle of Baku.headline: Bitka za Baku
paragraphs: Bitka za Baku (azerbajdžansko: Bakı döyüşü, turško: Bakü Muharebesi, rusko: Битва за Баку) je potekala avgusta in septembra 1918 med osmansko-azerbajdžanskimi koalicijskimi silami pod vodstvom Nuri paše in silami Bakujskega sovjeta, ki so ga sestavljali boljševiki in Armenska revolucionarna federacija, nasledile pa so jih britansko-armensko-belogardistične sile pod vodstvom Lionela Dunstervilla; v bitki je Sovjetska Rusija za kratek čas znova vstopila v vojno. Bitka je potekala med prvo svetovno vojno in je bila sklepni del kavkaške fronte, a hkrati začetek armensko-azerbajdžanske vojne.

source.title: Battle of Baku
paragraphs: The Battle of Baku (Azerbaijani: Bakı döyüşü, Turkish: Bakü Muharebesi, Russian: Битва за Баку) took place in August and September 1918 between the Ottoman–Azerbaijani coalition forces led by Nuri Pasha and Bolshevik–ARF Baku Soviet forces, later succeeded by the British–Armenian–White Russian forces led by Lionel Dunsterville, and saw Soviet Russia briefly re-enter the war. The battle took place during World War I, was a conclusive part of the Caucasus Campaign, but a beginning of the Armenian–Azerbaijani War.

Battle of Dandanaqan.headline: Bitka pri Dandanakanu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Dandanakanu (perzijsko: نبرد دندانقان) se je leta 1040 bila med seldžuškimi Turkmeni in Gaznavidi pri mestu Merv (danes v Turkmenistanu). Končala se je z odločilno seldžuško zmago, ki je nato strmoglavila gaznavidsko prevlado v Velikem Horasanu.

source.title: Battle of Dandanaqan
paragraphs: The Battle of Dandanaqan (Persian: نبرد دندانقان) was fought in 1040 between the Seljuq Turkmens and the Ghaznavid Empire near the city of Merv (now in Turkmenistan). The battle ended with a decisive Seljuq victory, which subsequently brought down the Ghaznavid domination in Greater Khorasan.

Bitka pri Didgorih (gruzijsko: დიდგორის ბრძოლა) se je 12. avgusta 1121 bila med vojskama Kraljestva Gruzije in Seldžuškega cesarstva v soteski Didgori, 40 km zahodno od Tbilisija. Velika muslimanska vojska pod poveljstvom Ilgazija se ni mogla razvrstiti in je zaradi učinkovite taktike kralja Davida IV. doživela uničujoč poraz.

Bitka pri Didgorih je bila vrhunec gruzijsko-seldžuških vojn in je Gruzijcem leta 1122 omogočila ponovno osvojitev Tbilisija. Kmalu zatem je David prestolnico preselil iz Kutaisija v Tbilisi. Zmaga pri Didgorih je začela srednjeveško gruzijsko zlato dobo, Gruzijske kronike pa jo slavijo kot »čudežno zmago« (gruzijsko: ძლევაჲ საკვირველი). Današnji Gruzijci se dogodka vsako leto 12. avgusta spominjajo s praznikom Didgoroba (»[dan] Didgorov«).
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi gruzijskih imen.

source.title: Battle of Didgori
paragraphs: The Battle of Didgori (Georgian: დიდგორის ბრძოლა, romanized: didgoris brdzola) was fought between the armies of the Kingdom of Georgia and the Seljuk Empire at the narrow place of Didgori, 40 km west of Tbilisi, on August 12, 1121. The large Muslim army, under the command of Ilghazi, was unable to maneuver and suffered a devastating defeat due to King David IV's effective military tactics.

The battle at Didgori was the culmination of the entire Georgian–Seljuk wars and led to the Georgians' reconquest of Tbilisi in 1122. Soon after that David moved the capital from Kutaisi to Tbilisi. The victory at Didgori inaugurated the medieval Georgian Golden Age and is celebrated in The Georgian Chronicles as a (Georgian: ძლევაჲ საკვირველი dzlevay sak'virveli lit. 'miraculous victory'). Modern Georgians continue to remember the event as an annual August 12 festival known as Didgoroba ('[the day] of Didgori').

Battle of Geok Tepe.headline: Bitka pri Geok Tepeju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Geok Tepeju leta 1881 je bila osrednji dogodek ruskega pohoda 1880/81, s katerim so Rusi hoteli podjarmiti turkmensko pleme Teke. Z njo je Ruski imperij dobil nadzor nad večino današnjega Turkmenistana in skoraj dokončal rusko osvojitev Srednje Azije.

Bitko imenujejo tudi Denghil-Tepe ali Dangil Teppe. Viri si niso enotni, vendar je bilo Denghil-Tepe najverjetneje ime utrdbe in hkrati majhnega griča ali gomile v njenem severozahodnem kotu. Geok Tepe (»Modri grič«) se po vsem sodeč nanaša na širše območje, današnje mesto, bližnjo vas in goro na jugu. Skrine piše, da je utrdba obsegala 2,6 kvadratnega kilometra ali več, z blatnimi zidovi, debelimi 5,5 m in na notranji strani visokimi 3 m, ter 1,2 m globokim suhim jarkom na zunanji strani, čeprav drugi navajajo drugačne mere. Območje je bilo del oaze Ahal, kjer potoki s Kopet Daga omogočajo namakalno poljedelstvo.
notes: Izpuščene so pretvorbe v kvadratne milje in čevlje.

source.title: Battle of Geok Tepe
paragraphs: The Battle of Geok Tepe in 1881 was the main event in the 1880/81 Russian campaign to conquer the Teke tribe of Turkmens. Its effect was to give the Russian Empire control over most of what is now Turkmenistan, thereby nearly completing the Russian conquest of Central Asia.

The battle is also called Denghil-Tepe or Dangil Teppe. Sources are inconsistent, but Denghil-Tepe seems to have been the name of the fort and also the name of a small hill or tumulus in the northwest corner of the fort. Geok Tepe ('Blue Hill') seems to refer to the general area, the modern town, a nearby village and a mountain to the south. Skrine says that fort enclosed 2.6 square kilometres (1 sq mi) or more, with mud walls 5.5 m (18 ft) thick and 3 m (10 ft) high on the inside and a 1.2 m (4 ft) dry ditch on the outside, although other dimensions are given. The area was part of the Akhal Oasis where streams coming down from the Kopet Dagh support irrigation agriculture.

Battle of Gol-Zarriun.headline: Bitka pri Gol-Zarriunu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Gol-Zarriunu, znana tudi kot bitka pri Buhari, je potekala okoli leta 563, ko sta se Sasanidsko cesarstvo in Prvi turški kaganat povezala proti Heftalitskemu cesarstvu.

source.title: Battle of Gol-Zarriun
paragraphs: The Battle of Gol-Zarriun, also known as Battle of Bukhara, took place around 563 when the Sasanian Empire and the First Turkic Khaganate allied with each other against the Hephthalite Empire.

Battle of Jaxartes.headline: Bitka ob Jaksartu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Jaksartu se je leta 329 pr. n. št. bila med Aleksandrom Velikim z njegovo helensko (grško) vojsko in Saki ob reki Jaksart, danes znani kot Sirdarja. Bojišče leži na stiku današnjih meja Uzbekistana, Tadžikistana, Kirgizistana in Kazahstana, jugozahodno od starodavnega mesta Taškent (današnje prestolnice Uzbekistana) in severovzhodno od Hudžanda (mesta v Tadžikistanu).

source.title: Battle of Jaxartes
paragraphs: The Battle of Jaxartes was fought in 329 BC by Alexander the Great and his Hellenic (Greek) army against the Saka at the River Jaxartes, now known as the Syr Darya River. The site of the battle straddles the modern borders of Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, Kyrgyzstan, and Kazakhstan, just south-west of the ancient city of Tashkent (the modern capital of Uzbekistan) and north-east of Khujand (a city in Tajikistan).

Battle of Kalbajar.headline: Bitka za Kalbadžar
paragraphs: Bitka za Kalbadžar je potekala marca in aprila 1993 med prvo vojno v Gorskem Karabahu. Končala se je tako, da so armenske vojaške sile zavzele azerbajdžanski okraj Kalbadžar.

Kalbadžar leži zunaj sporne enklave nekdanje Avtonomne pokrajine Gorski Karabah (NKAO). Z ofenzivo so armenske sile iz Gorskega Karabaha prvič prodrle čez meje enklave (če izvzamemo zavzetje Lačina leta 1992). Okraj Kalbadžar med Armenijo in zahodno mejo nekdanje NKAO je obsegal več deset vasi in okrajno središče, prav tako imenovano Kalbadžar. Armenska stran je napadla s štirih smeri, tudi iz same Armenije. Po začetnem hudem odporu se je azerbajdžanska obramba hitro sesula in okrajno središče je padlo 3. aprila 1993. Armenske sile so zavzele več kot 1900 kvadratnih kilometrov ozemlja in vzpostavile drugo kopensko povezavo med Armenijo in Gorskim Karabahom.

source.title: Battle of Kalbajar
paragraphs: The Battle of Kalbajar took place in March and April 1993, during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. It resulted in the capture of the Kalbajar District of Azerbaijan by Armenian military forces.

Kalbajar lies outside the contested enclave of the former Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast (NKAO). The offensive was the first time Armenian forces from Nagorno-Karabakh had advanced beyond the boundaries of the enclave (besides the capture of Lachin in 1992). Kalbajar District, located between Armenia and the western border of the former NKAO, was composed of several dozen villages and its provincial capital, also named Kalbajar. The Armenian side launched an attack from four directions, including Armenia proper. After initial heavy resistance, the Azerbaijani defence quickly collapsed and the provincial capital fell on April 3, 1993. Armenian forces captured an area of more than 1,900 square kilometres, establishing a second overland link between Armenia and Nagorno-Karabakh.

Battle of Karakilisa.headline: Bitka pri Karakilisi
paragraphs: Bitka pri Karakilisi (armensko: Ղարաքիլիսայի ճակատամարտ; turško: Karakilise Muharebesi ali Karakilise Muharebeleri) je potekala od 25. do 28. maja 1918 na kavkaški fronti prve svetovne vojne v okolici Karakilise (današnjega Vanadzorja).
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija armenskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Karakilisa
paragraphs: The Battle of Karakilisa (Armenian: Ղարաքիլիսայի ճակատամարտ Gharakilisayi chakatamart, Turkish: Karakilise Muharebesi or Karakilise Muharebeleri) took place during the Caucasus Campaign of World War I in the vicinity of Karakilisa (now Vanadzor), on May 25–28, 1918.

Battle of Korsakov.headline: Bitka pri Korsakovu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Korsakovu, pomorski spopad rusko-japonske vojne, se je bila 20. avgusta 1904 pred južno obalo otoka Sahalin. Bitka je preprečila poskus zaščitene križarke Novik ruske cesarske mornarice, da bi se iz Port Arthurja prebila do ruske eskadre križark v Vladivostoku, potem ko se je ruska pacifiška eskadra v bitki v Rumenem morju razkropila.

source.title: Battle of Korsakov
paragraphs: The Battle of Korsakov, a naval engagement of the Russo-Japanese War, was fought on 20 August 1904 off the southern coast of Sakhalin island. The battle foiled an attempt by the Imperial Russian Navy protected cruiser Novik at escaping Port Arthur to join the Russian cruiser squadron at Vladivostok, Russia, after the Russian Pacific Squadron was scattered in the Battle of the Yellow Sea.

Battle of Krtsanisi.headline: Bitka pri Krcanisiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Krcanisiju (gruzijsko: კრწანისის ბრძოლა; perzijsko: نبرد کرتسانیسی) se je od 8. do 11. septembra 1795 bila med vojsko kadžarskega Irana (Perzije) ter gruzijskimi vojskami Kraljestva Kartli-Kahetija in Kraljevine Imereti pri Krcanisiju blizu Tbilisija v Gruziji. Bila je del vojne, s katero je Aga Mohamed kan Kadžar odgovoril na zavezništvo gruzijskega kralja Herakleja II. z Ruskim imperijem. Bitka se je končala z odločilnim porazom Gruzijcev, zavzetjem in popolnim uničenjem njihove prestolnice Tbilisija ter začasno priključitvijo vzhodne Gruzije iranskemu cesarstvu.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Krtsanisi
paragraphs: The Battle of Krtsanisi (Georgian: კრწანისის ბრძოლა, romanized: k'rts'anisis brdzola, Persian: نبرد کرتسانیسی) was fought between the army of Qajar Iran (Persia) and the Georgian armies of the Kingdom of Kartli-Kakheti and Kingdom of Imereti at the place of Krtsanisi near Tbilisi, Georgia, from September 8 to September 11, 1795, as part of Agha Mohammad Khan Qajar's war in response to King Heraclius II of Georgia’s alliance with the Russian Empire. The battle resulted in the decisive defeat of the Georgians, capture, and complete destruction of their capital Tbilisi, as well as the temporary absorption of eastern Georgia into the Iranian empire.

Bitka pri Hasanskem jezeru (rusko: Хасанские бои), znana tudi kot incident Čangkufeng (kitajsko in japonsko: 張鼓峰事件), je bila poskus vojaškega vdora Mandžukua, japonske marionetne države, na ozemlje, ki ga je zahtevala in nadzorovala Sovjetska zveza. Vdor, do katerega je prišlo od 29. julija do 11. avgusta 1938, je izhajal iz japonskega prepričanja, da je Sovjetska zveza napačno razlagala razmejitev po pekinški pogodbi med carsko Rusijo in čingovsko Kitajsko ter nato premaknila mejnike. Japonske sile so zasedle sporno območje, vendar so se po hudih bojih in diplomatskem dogovoru umaknile.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa v pinjinu in romadžiju.

source.title: Battle of Lake Khasan
paragraphs: The Battle of Lake Khasan (Russian: Хасанские бои), also known as the Changkufeng Incident (Chinese and Japanese: 張鼓峰事件; Chinese pinyin: Zhānggǔfēng Shìjiàn; Japanese romaji: Chōkohō Jiken), was an attempted military incursion by Manchukuo, a Japanese puppet state, into territory claimed and controlled by the Soviet Union. The incursion, which occurred from 29 July to 11 August 1938, was founded in the Japanese belief that the Soviet Union had misinterpreted the demarcation of the boundary based on the Treaty of Peking between Imperial Russia and Qing China, and had subsequently tampered with the demarcation markers. Japanese forces occupied the disputed area but withdrew after heavy fighting and a diplomatic settlement.

Battle of Merv.headline: Bitka pri Mervu
paragraphs: Bitka pri Mervu (perzijsko: نبرد مرو) je potekala 2. decembra 1510, ko je šah Ismail I. s safavidsko vojsko vdrl v uzbeški Horasan. Končala se je s safavidsko priključitvijo Horasana.

source.title: Battle of Merv
paragraphs: The Battle of Merv (Persian: نبرد مرو) occurred on 2 December 1510 as a result of Shah Ismail I's Safavid invasion of the Khorasan region of Uzbek. It ended with Safavid annexation of the Khorasan region.

Battle of Sasireti.headline: Bitka pri Sasiretiju
paragraphs: Bitka pri Sasiretiju (gruzijsko: სასირეთის ბრძოლა) je potekala leta 1042 pri vasi Sasireti v današnji pokrajini Šida Kartli, nedaleč od mesta Kaspi, med državljansko vojno v Kraljestvu Gruziji. Uporni fevdalec Liparit IV. Kldekarski je v njej odločilno porazil vojsko kralja Bagrata IV.

source.title: Battle of Sasireti
paragraphs: The Battle of Sasireti (Georgian: სასირეთის ბრძოლა) took place in 1042 at the village of Sasireti in the present day Shida Kartli region, not far from the town of Kaspi, during the civil war in the Kingdom of Georgia. It resulted in a decisive defeat of the army of King Bagrat IV by the rebel feudal lord Liparit IV of Kldekari.

Battle of Shumshu.headline: Bitka za Šumšu
paragraphs: Bitka za Šumšu, sovjetska invazija na Šumšu na Kurilskih otokih, je bila prva faza sovjetske invazije na Kurilske otoke avgusta in septembra 1945 v drugi svetovni vojni. Potekala je od 18. do 23. avgusta 1945 in je bila edina večja bitka sovjetskega pohoda na Kurilske otoke ter verjetno sploh zadnja bitka druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Battle of Shumshu
paragraphs: The Battle of Shumshu, the Soviet invasion of Shumshu in the Kuril Islands, was the first stage of the Soviet Union's Invasion of the Kuril Islands in August–September 1945 during World War II. It took place from 18 to 23 August 1945, and was the only major battle of the Soviet campaign in the Kuril Islands and arguably the very last battle of World War II.

Battle of Shusha (1992).headline: Bitka za Šušo (1992)
paragraphs: Bitka za Šušo (armensko: Շուշի, Šuši; kodno ime operacija Poroka v gorah, armensko: Հարսանիք լեռներում, rusko: Свадьба в горах) je bila prva pomembna vojaška zmaga armenskih sil v prvi vojni v Gorskem Karabahu. Bitka se je začela zvečer 8. maja 1992 v strateško pomembnem gorskem mestu Šuša, boji pa so se hitro končali naslednji dan, ko so armenske sile mesto zavzele in pregnale azerbajdžanske branilce. Armenski vojaški poveljniki s sedežem v Stepanakertu, prestolnici Gorskega Karabaha, so zavzetje mesta pretehtavali, potem ko je azerbajdžansko obstreljevanje Stepanakerta iz Šuše pol leta terjalo več sto armenskih civilnih žrtev in povzročilo veliko razdejanje v Stepanakertu.

Zavzetje mesta se je izkazalo za odločilno. Šuša je bila najpomembnejše vojaško oporišče, ki ga je imel Azerbajdžan v Gorskem Karabahu – z njeno izgubo se je vojna obrnila, armenske sile pa so v nadaljevanju spopada dosegle vrsto vojaških zmag.
notes: Izpuščeni sta latinični transliteraciji armenskega in ruskega kodnega imena.

source.title: Battle of Shusha (1992)
paragraphs: The Battle of Shusha (Codenamed: Operation Wedding in The Mountains; Armenian: Հարսանիք լեռներում, Harsaniq lernerum; Russian: Свадьба в горах, Svadba v gorakh) (Armenian: Շուշի, Shushi) was the first significant military victory by Armenian forces during the First Nagorno-Karabakh War. The battle took place in the strategically important mountain town of Shusha on the evening of 8 May 1992, and fighting swiftly concluded the next day after Armenian forces captured it and drove out the defending Azerbaijanis. Armenian military commanders based in Nagorno-Karabakh's capital of Stepanakert had been contemplating capturing the town after Azerbaijani shelling of Stepanakert from Shusha for half a year had led to hundreds of Armenian civilian casualties and mass destruction in Stepanakert.

The capture of the town proved decisive. Shusha was the most important military stronghold that Azerbaijan held in Nagorno-Karabakh – its loss marked a turning point in the war, and led to a series of military victories by Armenian forces in the course of the conflict.

Battle of Shusha (2020).headline: Bitka za Šušo (2020)
paragraphs: Bitka za Šušo (azerbajdžansko: Şuşa döyüşü ali Şuşa uğrunda döyüş; armensko: Շուշիի ճակատամարտ) je bila zadnja in odločilna bitka vojne v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020, v kateri so se oborožene sile Azerbajdžana in samooklicane Republike Arcah, ki jo je vojaško podpirala Armenija, bojevale za nadzor nad mestom Šuša. Velja za eno najbolj krvavih bitk te vojne.

Šuša, ki jo Armenci imenujejo Šuši, je skupaj z gorato okolico eden strateško najpomembnejših krajev v spornem Gorskem Karabahu in jo navadno imenujejo »utripajoče srce« regije. Do sredine 19. stoletja je mesto veljalo za kulturno in politično središče tamkajšnjega azerbajdžanskega prebivalstva, za Armence pa je bilo eno od dveh glavnih mest Zakavkazja in od srednjega veka do 1750. let središče samoupravne armenske kneževine.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija armenskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Shusha (2020)
paragraphs: The Battle of Shusha (Azerbaijani: Şuşa döyüşü or Şuşa uğrunda döyüş; Armenian: Շուշիի ճակատամարտ, romanized: Shushii chakatamart) was the final and decisive battle of the Second Nagorno-Karabakh War, fought between the armed forces of Azerbaijan and the self-proclaimed Republic of Artsakh, militarily supported by Armenia, over the control of the city of Shusha. The battle is considered one of the bloodiest battles of the war.

Shusha, known to Armenians as Shushi, and the surrounding mountainous terrain, is one of the most strategically important locations in the disputed Nagorno-Karabakh region, and is usually referred to as the "beating heart" of the region. Until the middle of the 19th century, the city was considered the cultural and political centre of the regional Azerbaijani population, as well as one of the two main cities of the Transcaucasus for Armenians and the center of a self-governing Armenian principality from medieval times through the 1750s.

Battle of Talas.headline: Bitka ob Talasu
paragraphs: Bitka ob Talasu (kitajsko: 怛羅斯戰役; arabsko: معركة نهر طلاس) je bila oborožen spopad med Abasidskim kalifatom in Tibetanskim imperijem na eni strani ter dinastijo Tang in njenimi zavezniki na drugi leta 751. Julija tega leta sta se tangovska in abasidska vojska spopadli ob reki Talas za nadzor nad območji ob Sirdarji. Abasidska vojska pod poveljstvom Zijada ibn Saliha in karluški plačanci so porazili tangovsko vojsko pod poveljstvom Gao Šjendžija. Viri si niso enotni, ali so Karluki prestopili k Abasidom ali pa so bili njihovi zavezniki že od začetka. Poraz je pomenil konec tangovskega vpliva v Transoksaniji in ustavil širjenje dinastije Tang proti zahodu.

Po bitki je kalif poslal k cesarju odposlanca, ki je decembra 752 prispel na pogajanja o obnovi diplomatskih odnosov. Kitajski ujetniki, zajeti pri Talasu leta 751, naj bi ljudstvom zahodne Azije prinesli izdelovanje papirja, čeprav to poročilo izpodbijajo številne ugotovitve.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapis v pinjinu in latinična transliteracija arabskega imena.

source.title: Battle of Talas
paragraphs: The Battle of Talas (Chinese: 怛羅斯戰役; pinyin: Dáluósī Zhànyì; Arabic: معركة نهر طلاس, romanized: Maʿrakat nahr Ṭalās) was an armed confrontation between the Abbasid Caliphate along with the Tibetan Empire against the Tang dynasty and its allies in 751. In July of that year, the Tang and Abbasid armies clashed at the Talas River over control of the regions surrounding the Syr Darya. The Tang army under Gao Xianzhi was defeated by the Abbasid army under Ziyad ibn Salih and Karluk mercenaries. Sources differ on whether the Karluks defected to the Abbasids or if they were Abbasid allies from the start. The defeat marked the end of Tang influence in Transoxiana and halted Tang westward expansion.

After the battle, the caliph dispatched an envoy to the emperor, who arrived in December 752 to negotiate the restoration of diplomatic relations. Chinese prisoners captured at Talas in 751 are said to have introduced papermaking to the peoples of West Asia, although this account is disputed by several findings.

Battle of the Defile.headline: Bitka v soteski
paragraphs: Bitka v soteski ali bitka na prelazu (arabsko: وقعة الشعب) se je julija 731 n. št. tri dni bila na prelazu Tahtakarača (v današnjem Uzbekistanu) med veliko vojsko Omajadskega kalifata in Turgeškim kaganatom. Turgeši so oblegali Samarkand, samarkandski poveljnik Savra ibn al-Hurr al-Abani pa je novoimenovanega upravitelja Horasana Džunajda ibn Abd al-Rahmana al-Murrija zaprosil za pomoč. Turgeši so Džunajdovo vojsko z 28.000 možmi napadli na prelazu; omajadska vojska se je sicer izvila in prišla do Samarkanda, vendar je utrpela ogromne izgube, Savrovih 12.000 mož, ki so dobili ukaz, naj Turgeše napadejo od zadaj, pa je bilo skoraj povsem uničenih.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija arabskega imena.

source.title: Battle of the Defile
paragraphs: The Battle of the Defile or Battle of the Pass (Arabic: وقعة الشعب, romanized: Waqʿat al-Shʿib) was fought in the Takhtakaracha Pass (in modern Uzbekistan) between a large army of the Umayyad Caliphate and the Turkic Türgesh khaganate over three days in July 731 CE. The Türgesh had been besieging Samarkand, and Samarkand's commander, Sawra ibn al-Hurr al-Abani, had sent a request for relief to the newly appointed governor of Khurasan, Junayd ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Murri. Junayd's 28,000-strong army was attacked by the Türgesh in the pass, and although the Umayyad army managed to extricate itself and reach Samarkand, it suffered enormous casualties; Sawra's 12,000 men, who had been commanded to attack the Türgesh from the rear in a relief effort, were almost annihilated.

Battle of Tskhinvali.headline: Bitka za Chinvali
paragraphs: Bitka za Chinvali (2008) (gruzijsko: ცხინვალის ბრძოლა; rusko: Бои за Цхинвали) je bila boj za mesto Chinvali, prestolnico samooklicane Republike Južna Osetija. Bila je edina večja bitka rusko-gruzijske vojne. Gruzijske kopenske čete so v mesto vstopile zgodaj zjutraj 8. avgusta 2008. Po treh dneh hudih bojev z južnoosetijsko milico in ruskimi četami so se gruzijske čete zvečer 10. avgusta dokončno umaknile iz mesta. Do 11. avgusta so vse gruzijske čete zapustile Južno Osetijo, ruske sile pa so brez odpora prodrle na nesporno gruzijsko ozemlje.

source.title: Battle of Tskhinvali
paragraphs: The Battle of Tskhinvali (2008) (Georgian: ცხინვალის ბრძოლა; Russian: Бои за Цхинвали) was a fight for the city of Tskhinvali, the capital of the self-proclaimed Republic of South Ossetia. It was the only major battle in the Russo-Georgian War. Georgian ground troops entered the city on early 8 August 2008. After the three-day fierce fighting with South Ossetian militia and Russian troops, Georgian troops finally withdrew from the city on the evening of 10 August. By 11 August, all Georgian troops had left South Ossetia and Russian forces advanced into undisputed Georgia facing no resistance.

Battle of Zhizhi.headline: Bitka z Džidžijem
paragraphs: Bitka z Džidžijem (郅支之戰) se je leta 36 pr. n. št. bila med dinastijo Han in poglavarjem ljudstva Šiungnu Džidži čanjüjem. Džidži je bil poražen in ubit. Bitka se je najverjetneje bila pri Talasu ob reki Talas na kazahstansko-kirgiški meji, kar jo uvršča med najzahodnejše točke, do katerih je kdaj prišla kitajska vojska. Na istem območju je leta 751 n. št. potekala bitka ob Talasu.

source.title: Battle of Zhizhi
paragraphs: The Battle of Zhizhi (郅支之戰) was fought in 36 BC between the Han dynasty and the Xiongnu chieftain Zhizhi Chanyu. Zhizhi was defeated and killed. The battle was probably fought near Talas on the Talas River on the Kazakhstan–Kyrgyzstan border, which makes it one of the westernmost points reached by a Chinese army. The Battle of Talas in 751 AD was fought in the same area.

Black January.headline: Črni januar
paragraphs: Črni januar (azerbajdžansko: Qara Yanvar), znan tudi kot črna sobota ali januarski pokol, je bil nasilen obračun s protisovjetskimi in protiarmenskimi razpoloženji, azerbajdžanskim nacionalizmom in iredentizmom v Bakuju 19. in 20. januarja 1990, v okviru izrednih razmer med razpadom Sovjetske zveze.

Generalni sekretar Komunistične partije Sovjetske zveze Mihail Gorbačov in obrambni minister Dmitrij Jazov sta trdila, da je bilo vojno stanje nujno, da bi preprečili poskuse azerbajdžanskega osamosvojitvenega gibanja, ki je hotelo strmoglaviti sovjetsko azerbajdžansko vlado. Po uradnih azerbajdžanskih ocenah je bilo ubitih 147 civilistov, 800 ljudi ranjenih, pet pa jih je izginilo.

Vrhovni sovjet Azerbajdžanske SSR je v resoluciji 22. januarja 1990 razglasil, da je odlok predsedstva Vrhovnega sovjeta ZSSR z 19. januarja, s katerim so v Bakuju uvedli izredne razmere in napotili vojsko, pomenil dejanje agresije.

source.title: Black January
paragraphs: Black January (Azerbaijani: Qara Yanvar), also known as Black Saturday or the January Massacre, was a violent crackdown on anti-Soviet and anti-Armenian sentiments, Azerbaijani nationalism, and irredentism in Baku on 19 and 20 January 1990, as part of a state of emergency during the dissolution of the Soviet Union.

General Secretary of the Soviet Communist Party Mikhail Gorbachev and Defence Minister Dmitry Yazov asserted that military law was necessary to thwart efforts by the Azerbaijani independence movement to overthrow the Soviet Azerbaijani government. According to official estimates of Azerbaijan, 147 civilians were killed, 800 people were injured, and five people went missing.

In a resolution of 22 January 1990, the Supreme Soviet of Azerbaijan SSR declared that the decree of the Presidium of the Supreme Soviet of the USSR of 19 January, used to impose emergency rule in Baku and military deployment, constituted an act of aggression.

Convention on the legal status of the Ca.headline: Konvencija o pravnem statusu Kaspijskega jezera
paragraphs: Konvencija o pravnem statusu Kaspijskega jezera je pogodba, ki so jo 12. avgusta 2018 v Aktauu v Kazahstanu podpisali predsedniki Rusije, Kazahstana, Azerbajdžana, Irana in Turkmenistana.

source.title: Convention on the legal status of the Caspian Sea
paragraphs: The Convention on the legal status of the Caspian Sea is a treaty signed in Aktau, Kazakhstan, on 12 August 2018 by the presidents of Russia, Kazakhstan, Azerbaijan, Iran and Turkmenistan.

Day of Thirst.headline: Dan žeje
paragraphs: »Dan žeje« (arabsko: ﻳﻮﻢ ﺍلعطش) je ime, ki ga arabsko zgodovinopisje tradicionalno daje bitki leta 724 med Turgeškim kaganatom in Omajadskim kalifatom na bregovih Sirdarje v Transoksaniji (v današnjem Tadžikistanu v Srednji Aziji). Omajadska vojska pod poveljstvom Muslima ibn Saida al-Kilabija je bila na pohodu v Ferganski dolini, ko je izvedela, da Turgeši napredujejo. Arabci so se takoj začeli naglo umikati proti Sirdarji, turgeška konjenica pa jih je zasledovala in nadlegovala. Po 11 dneh je omajadska vojska nazadnje prišla do reke, kjer se je znašla ujeta med Turgeši in silami domačih transoksanskih kneževin. Arabcem se je vseeno uspelo prebiti in prečkati reko do Hudžanda. Omajadski poraz je privedel do zloma muslimanske oblasti nad velikim delom regije, ki je do okoli leta 740 ostala sporno ozemlje, za katero so se bojevali Arabci in Turgeši.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija arabskega imena.

source.title: Day of Thirst
paragraphs: The "Day of Thirst" (Arabic: ﻳﻮﻢ ﺍلعطش, romanized: Yawm al-aṭash) is the name traditionally given in Arabic historiography to a battle fought in 724 between the Turkic Türgesh Khaganate and the Umayyad Caliphate on the banks of the Syr Darya river, in Transoxiana (in modern Tajikistan, Central Asia). The Umayyad army, under Muslim ibn Sa'id al-Kilabi, was campaigning in the Ferghana Valley when it learned of the Türgesh advance. Immediately, the Arabs began a hasty retreat to the Syr Darya, pursued and harassed by the Türgesh cavalry. Finally, after 11 days, the Umayyad army reached the river, where it was caught between the Türgesh and the forces of the native Transoxianian principalities. Nevertheless, the Arabs managed to break through and cross the river to Khujand. The Umayyad defeat led to the collapse of Muslim rule over much of the region, which until c. 740 remained disputed territory, with both the Arabs and the Türgesh fighting for control over it.

Duranski imperij, pogovorno znan tudi kot Kraljevina Afganistan, Afganski imperij ali Sadozajsko kraljestvo, je bil afganski imperij, ki ga je leta 1747 ustanovil Ahmad Šah Durani iz paštunskega plemena Durani. Segal je čez dele Srednje Azije, Iranske planote in Indijske podceline. Na vrhuncu je obsegal današnji Afganistan, velik del Pakistana, dele severovzhodnega in jugovzhodnega Irana, vzhodni Turkmenistan in severozahodno Indijo. Duranski imperij velja ob Osmanskem cesarstvu za enega najpomembnejših islamskih imperijev druge polovice 18. stoletja.

source.title: Durrani Empire
paragraphs: The Durrani Empire, colloquially known as the Kingdom of Afghanistan, the Afghan Empire, or the Sadozai Kingdom, was an Afghan empire founded in 1747 by Ahmad Shah Durrani, of the Pashtun Durrani tribe. The empire spanned parts of Central Asia, the Iranian plateau, and the Indian subcontinent. At its peak, it ruled over present-day Afghanistan, much of Pakistan, parts of northeastern and southeastern Iran, eastern Turkmenistan, and northwestern India. Alongside the Ottoman Empire, the Durrani Empire is considered one of the most significant Islamic empires of the second half of the 18th century.

Vzhodni Turkestan (ujgursko: شەرقىي تۈركىستان, Шәрқий Туркистан) je ohlapno opredeljena geografska regija na severozahodu Ljudske republike Kitajske, na stičišču Vzhodne in Srednje Azije. Izraz so v 19. stoletju skovali ruski turkologi, med njimi Nikita Bičurin, ki so z njim hoteli nadomestiti običajni zahodni izraz za regijo, »Kitajski Turkestan«, ki se je nanašal na Tarimsko kotlino na jugu Šinjianga. Od 17. stoletja je bilo ujgursko ime za Tarimsko kotlino Altišahr, kar v ujgurščini pomeni »šest mest«. Ujguri so Tarimsko kotlino imenovali tudi »Yettishar« (»sedem mest«) in celo »Sekkizshahr« (»osem mest«). Kitajske dinastije od dinastije Han do dinastije Tang so delno prekrivajoče se območje imenovale »Zahodne pokrajine«.
notes: Izpuščen je latinični zapis ujgurskega imena (ULY).

source.title: East Turkestan
paragraphs: East Turkestan or East Turkistan (Uyghur: شەرقىي تۈركىستان, ULY: Sherqiy Türkistan, UKY: Шәрқий Туркистан) is a loosely defined geographical region in the northwestern part of the People's Republic of China, on the cross roads of East and Central Asia. The term was coined in the 19th century by Russian Turkologists, including Nikita Bichurin, who intended the name to replace the common Western term for the region, "Chinese Turkestan", which referred to the Tarim Basin in Southern Xinjiang. Beginning in the 17th century, Altishahr, which means "Six Cities" in Uyghur, became the Uyghur name for the Tarim Basin. Uyghurs also called the Tarim Basin "Yettishar," which means "Seven Cities," and even "Sekkizshahr", which means "Eight Cities" in Uyghur. Chinese dynasties from the Han dynasty to the Tang dynasty had called an overlapping area the "Western Regions".

Prva vojna v Gorskem Karabahu je bila etnični in ozemeljski spopad, ki je od februarja 1988 do maja 1994 potekal v enklavi Gorski Karabah na jugozahodu Azerbajdžana med večinskimi etničnimi Armenci Gorskega Karabaha, ki jih je podpirala Armenija, in Republiko Azerbajdžan, ki jo je podpirala Turčija. Ko se je vojna razvijala, sta se Armenija in Azerbajdžan, nekdanji sovjetski republiki, zapletla v dolgotrajno, nenapovedano gorsko vojskovanje na karabaških višinah, saj je Azerbajdžan poskušal zatreti karabaško gibanje.

source.title: First Nagorno-Karabakh War
paragraphs: The First Nagorno-Karabakh War was an ethnic and territorial conflict that took place from February 1988 to May 1994 in the enclave of Nagorno-Karabakh in southwestern Azerbaijan between the majority ethnic Armenians of Nagorno-Karabakh backed by Armenia, and the Republic of Azerbaijan with support from Turkey. As the war progressed, Armenia and Azerbaijan, both former Soviet republics, entangled themselves in protracted, undeclared mountain warfare in the mountainous heights of Karabakh as Azerbaijan attempted to curb the Karabakh Movement.

Georgia.headline: Gruzija
paragraphs: Angleško ime Georgia se najpogosteje nanaša na:
Gruzijo, državo na južnem Kavkazu,
Georgio, zvezno državo na jugovzhodu ZDA.
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Georgia
paragraphs: Georgia most commonly refers to:
Georgia (country), in the South Caucasus
Georgia (U.S. state), a state in the Southeastern US

Gruzijska državljanska vojna 1991–1993 (gruzijsko: 1991–1993 წლების ქართული სამოქალაქო ომი) je od leta 1991 do 1993 potekala v južnokavkaški državi Gruziji. Začela se je decembra 1991 z udarom, ki so ga uporniške frakcije gruzijske nacionalne garde in paravojaška skupina Mhedrioni izvedle proti prvemu demokratično izvoljenemu gruzijskemu predsedniku Zviadu Gamsahurdiji. Predsednik Gamsahurdia je zato pobegnil v sosednjo Čečenijo, nato pa je v letih 1992–1993 vodil uporništvo in neuspešno vstajo, da bi znova prišel na oblast.

source.title: Georgian civil war of 1991–1993
paragraphs: The Georgian civil war of 1991–1993 (Georgian: 1991–1993 წლების ქართული სამოქალაქო ომი) lasted from 1991 to 1993 in the South Caucasian country Georgia. It began in December 1991 with the coup against the first democratically-elected President of Georgia, Zviad Gamsakhurdia, by the rebel factions of the Georgian National Guard and the Mkhedrioni paramilitary. It led to President Gamsakhurdia fleeing to neighboring Chechnya, and his subsequent insurgency and unsuccessful uprising to regain power in 1992–1993.

Gruzijsko-osetijski konflikt je etnopolitični spor glede nekdanje gruzijske avtonomne pokrajine Južna Osetija, ki je nastal leta 1989 in v letih 1991–1992 prerasel v vojno. Kljub razglašenemu premirju in številnim mirovnim prizadevanjem je spor, v katerega so vpletene Gruzija, Rusija in samooklicana republika Južna Osetija, ostal nerazrešen. Avgusta 2008 so vojaške napetosti in spopadi prerasli v rusko-gruzijsko vojno. Od tedaj je Južna Osetija de facto pod ruskim nadzorom.

source.title: Georgian–Ossetian conflict
paragraphs: The Georgian–Ossetian conflict is an ethno-political conflict over Georgia's former autonomous region of South Ossetia, which evolved in 1989 and developed into a war in 1991–1992. Despite a declared ceasefire and numerous peace efforts, the conflict, involving Georgia, Russia and self-proclaimed republic of South Ossetia, remained unresolved. In August 2008, military tensions and clashes erupted into the Russo-Georgian War. Since then, South Ossetia has been under de facto Russian control.

Gruzijsko-južnoosetijski konflikt v letih 1918–1920 je bil vrsta vstaj na območjih, poseljenih z Osetinci, v današnji Južni Osetiji, odcepljeni republiki v Gruziji, najprej proti Zakavkaški demokratični federativni republiki, nato pa proti Demokratični republiki Gruziji, v kateri so prevladovali menjševiki.

Menjševiška vlada Gruzije je med kratkim obstojem naletela na resne težave z etničnimi Osetinci, ki so večinoma simpatizirali z boljševiki in Sovjetsko Rusijo. Vzroki za spopad so bili zapleteni. Zapoznela zemljiška reforma in kmečki nemiri na revnih osetinskih območjih so se prepletali z etničnimi razprtijami in bojem za oblast na Kavkazu.

source.title: Georgian–Ossetian conflicts of 1918-1920
paragraphs: The Georgian–Ossetian conflict of 1918–1920 were a series of uprisings, which took place in the Ossetian-inhabited areas of what is now South Ossetia, a breakaway republic in Georgia, against the Transcaucasian Democratic Federative Republic and then the Menshevik-dominated Democratic Republic of Georgia.

During its brief tenure, the Menshevik government of Georgia came across significant problems with ethnic Ossetians who largely sympathized with the Bolsheviks and Soviet Russia. The reasons behind the conflict were complicated. An overdue land reform and agrarian disturbances in the poor Ossetian-populated areas intermingled with ethnic discord and the struggle for power in the Caucasus.

Uporništvo na Severnem Kavkazu je bilo oborožen spopad nizke intenzivnosti med Rusijo in borci, povezanimi s Kavkaškim emiratom ter od junija 2015 z Islamsko državo, na Severnem Kavkazu. Sledilo je (od Rusije razglašenemu) uradnemu koncu desetletne druge čečenske vojne 16. aprila 2009. Privabilo je prostovoljce z Bližnjega vzhoda in iz Severne Afrike, zahodne Evrope in Srednje Azije. Ruska zakonodaja drugo čečensko vojno in to uporništvo obravnava kot iste »protiteroristične operacije na ozemlju severnokavkaške regije«.

V poznejših letih je uporništvo razmeroma zamrlo. Na vrhuncu se je nasilje zgoščalo predvsem v severnokavkaških republikah Čečeniji, Dagestanu, Ingušetiji in Kabardino-Balkariji. Občasni incidenti so se zgodili tudi v okoliških regijah, kot so Severna Osetija–Alanija, Karačajevo-Čerkezija, Stavropolski okraj in Volgograjska oblast.

source.title: Insurgency in the North Caucasus
paragraphs: The insurgency in the North Caucasus was a low-level armed conflict between Russia and militants associated with the Caucasus Emirate and, from June 2015, the Islamic State, in the North Caucasus. It followed the (Russian-proclaimed) official end of the decade-long Second Chechen War on 16 April 2009. It attracted volunteers from the MENA region, Western Europe, and Central Asia. The Russian legislation considers the Second Chechen War and the insurgency described in this article as the same "counter-terrorist operations on the territory of the North Caucasus region".

The insurgency became relatively dormant in its later years. During its peak, the violence was mostly concentrated in the North Caucasus republics of Chechnya, Dagestan, Ingushetia and Kabardino-Balkaria. Occasional incidents happened in surrounding regions, such as North Ossetia–Alania, Karachay-Cherkessia, Stavropol Krai, and Volgograd Oblast.

Japanese invasion of Sakhalin.headline: Japonska invazija na Sahalin
paragraphs: Japonska invazija na Sahalin je bila zadnja kopenska bitka rusko-japonske vojne in je potekala od 7. do 31. julija 1905.

source.title: Japanese invasion of Sakhalin
paragraphs: The Japanese invasion of Sakhalin was the last land battle of the Russo-Japanese War, and took place from 7 July to 31 July 1905.

Jin dynasty (1115-1234).headline: Dinastija Džin (1115–1234)
paragraphs: Dinastija Džin (kitajsko: 金朝), uradno Veliki Džin (大金), je bila cesarska dinastija Kitajske pod vodstvom Džurčenov in cesarstvo, ki mu je vladal klan Vanjen, obstajala pa je od leta 1115 do 1234. Po vladajočem ljudstvu jo pogosto imenujejo tudi džurčenska dinastija ali džurčenski Džin. Na vrhuncu je cesarstvo segalo od Zunanje Mandžurije na severu do črte Činling–Huajhe na jugu.

Dinastija Džin je nastala z uporom Vanjena Agude proti dinastiji Ljao (916–1125), ki je obvladovala severno Kitajsko, dokler je mladi Džin ni pregnal v Zahodne pokrajine, kjer je v kitajskem zgodovinopisju znana kot Zahodni Ljao. Po osvojitvi ozemlja Ljaa je Džin začel stoletje dolg pohod proti dinastiji Song (960–1279) s središčem na jugu Kitajske, katere vladarji so bili po narodnosti Hani. Džinski cesarji so se med vladavino prilagodili hanskim šegam in celo utrdili Kitajski zid proti vzpenjajočemu se Mongolskemu cesarstvu. Džin je spodbujal tudi vrsto kulturnih dosežkov v državi, denimo oživitev konfucianizma.
notes: Izpuščen je zapis v pinjinu; kitajska pismenka ostaja.

source.title: Jin dynasty (1115–1234)
paragraphs: The Jin dynasty (Chinese: 金朝; pinyin: Jīn cháo), officially the Great Jin (大金; Dà Jīn), was a Jurchen-led imperial dynasty of China and empire ruled by the Wanyan clan that existed between 1115 and 1234. It is also often called the Jurchen dynasty or the Jurchen Jin after the ruling Jurchen people. At its peak, the empire extended from Outer Manchuria in the north to the Qinling–Huaihe Line in the south.

The Jin dynasty emerged from Wanyan Aguda's rebellion against the Liao dynasty (916–1125), which held sway over northern China until being driven by the nascent Jin to the Western Regions, where they would become known in Chinese historiography as the Western Liao. After conquering the Liao territory, the Jin launched a century-long campaign against the Song dynasty (960–1279) based in southern China, whose rulers were ethnically Han Chinese. Over the course of the Jin's rule, their emperors adapted to Han customs and even fortified the Great Wall against the ascendant Mongol Empire. The Jin also oversaw a number of internal cultural advances, such as the revival of Confucianism.

Khivan campaign of 1839–1840.headline: Hivski pohod 1839–1840
paragraphs: Hivski pohod 1839–1840 je bil neuspešen ruski poskus osvojitve Hivskega kanata. Vasilij Perovski se je s 5000 možmi odpravil iz Orenburga, naletel na nenavadno mrzlo zimo, izgubil večino kamel in se moral na pol poti vrniti.

Rusi so Hivo napadli štirikrat. Okoli leta 1602 so svobodni kozaki trikrat vdrli v Hivo. Leta 1717 je Hivo napadel Aleksander Bekovič-Čerkaski in bil do kraja poražen, le nekaj mož je pobegnilo, da so lahko povedali, kaj se je zgodilo. Po ruskem porazu v letih 1839–1840 so Rusi Hivo nazadnje osvojili s hivskim pohodom leta 1873.

source.title: Khivan campaign of 1839–1840
paragraphs: The Khivan campaign of 1839–1840 was a failed Russian attempt to conquer the Khanate of Khiva. Vasily Perovsky set out from Orenburg with 5,000 men, met an unusually cold winter, lost most of his camels, and was forced to turn back after going halfway.

Russians attacked Khiva four times. Around 1602, some free Cossacks made three raids on Khiva. In 1717, Alexander Bekovich-Cherkassky attacked Khiva and was soundly defeated, only a few men escaping to tell the tale. After the Russian defeat in 1839–1840, Khiva was finally conquered by the Russians during the Khivan campaign of 1873.

Kidarites.headline: Kidariti
paragraphs: Kidariti ali kidarski Huni so bili dinastija, ki je v 4. in 5. stoletju vladala Baktriji in sosednjim delom Srednje Azije in Pakistana. Kidariti so pripadali zapleteni skupini ljudstev, ki so jo v dolini Inda skupaj imenovali Huna, v Evropi pa Hioniti (po iranskih imenih Xwn/Xyon), in jih morda lahko celo enačimo s Hioniti. Bizantinski zgodovinar Prisk iz 5. stoletja jih je imenoval kidaritski Huni oziroma »Huni, ki so Kidariti«. Kitajski anali so jih imenovali Ta Yüeh-chih ali Mali Yüeh-chih. Plemena Huna oziroma Hionitov pogosto, čeprav sporno, povezujejo s Huni, ki so v istem obdobju vdrli v vzhodno Evropo. S Heftaliti, ki so jih zamenjali približno stoletje pozneje, nimajo nič skupnega.

source.title: Kidarites
paragraphs: The Kidarites, or Kidara Huns, were a dynasty that ruled Bactria and adjoining parts of Central Asia and Pakistan in the 4th and 5th centuries. The Kidarites belonged to a complex group of peoples known collectively in the Indus Valley as the Huna, and in Europe as the Chionites (from the Iranian names Xwn/Xyon), and may even be considered as identical to the Chionites. The 5th century Byzantine historian Priscus called them Kidarite Huns, or "Huns who are Kidarites". Chinese annals referred to them as the Ta Yüeh-chih, or Lesser Yüeh-chih. The Huna/Xionite tribes are often linked, albeit controversially, to the Huns who invaded Eastern Europe around the same period. They are entirely different from the Hephthalites, who replaced them about a century later.

Kraljestvo Kahetija (gruzijsko: კახეთის სამეფო; tudi Kaxet'i ali Kakhetia), poznosrednjeveška in zgodnjenovoveška monarhija v vzhodni Gruziji, je imelo središče v pokrajini Kahetija, prestolnico pa najprej v Gremiju in nato v Telaviju. Nastalo je ob tridelni razdelitvi Kraljestva Gruzije leta 1466 in z več kratkimi prekinitvami obstajalo do leta 1762, ko sta se Kahetija in sosednje gruzijsko kraljestvo Kartli z dinastičnim nasledstvom združila pod kahetijsko vejo dinastije Bagrationi. Večino tega časa je bilo kraljestvo vazal zaporednih iranskih dinastij, krajši čas pa Osmanskega cesarstva, vendar je občasno, zlasti po letu 1747, uživalo večjo neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena. Vir postavlja tridelno razdelitev Gruzije tu v leto 1466, v povzetku o Kartliju pa v leto 1478; prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Kingdom of Kakheti
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Kakheti (Georgian: კახეთის სამეფო, romanized: k'akhetis samepo; also spelled Kaxet'i or Kakhetia) was a late medieval and early modern monarchy in eastern Georgia, centered at the province of Kakheti, with its capital first at Gremi and then at Telavi. It emerged in the process of a tripartite division of the Kingdom of Georgia in 1466 and existed, with several brief intermissions, until 1762 when Kakheti and the neighboring Georgian kingdom of Kartli were merged through a dynastic succession under the Kakhetian branch of the Bagrationi dynasty. Through much of this period, the kingdom was a vassal of the successive dynasties of Iran, and to a much shorter period Ottoman Empire, but enjoyed intermittent periods of greater independence, especially after 1747.

Kraljestvo Kartli (gruzijsko: ქართლის სამეფო), poznosrednjeveška in zgodnjenovoveška monarhija v vzhodni Gruziji, je imelo središče v pokrajini Kartli in prestolnico v Tbilisiju. Nastalo je ob tridelni razdelitvi Kraljestva Gruzije leta 1478 in z več kratkimi prekinitvami obstajalo do leta 1762, ko sta se Kartli in sosednje gruzijsko kraljestvo Kahetija z dinastičnim nasledstvom združila pod kahetijsko vejo dinastije Bagrationi. Večino tega časa je bilo kraljestvo vazal zaporednih iranskih dinastij, krajši čas pa Osmanskega cesarstva, vendar je občasno, zlasti po letu 1747, uživalo večjo neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Kingdom of Kartli
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Kartli (Georgian: ქართლის სამეფო, romanized: kartlis samepo) was a late medieval and early modern monarchy in eastern Georgia, centred on the province of Kartli, with its capital at Tbilisi. It emerged in the process of a tripartite division of the Kingdom of Georgia in 1478 and existed, with several brief intervals, until 1762 when Kartli and the neighbouring Georgian kingdom of Kakheti were merged through dynastic succession under the Kakhetian branch of the Bagrationi dynasty. Through much of this period, the kingdom was a vassal of the successive dynasties of Iran, and to a much shorter period Ottoman Empire, but enjoyed intermittent periods of greater independence, especially after 1747.

Kingdom of Khotan.headline: Kraljestvo Hotan
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Hotan, imenovano tudi kraljestvo Jutjan (kitajsko: 于闐), je bilo starodavno budistično saško kraljestvo na veji svilne poti, ki je potekala ob južnem robu puščave Taklamakan v Tarimski kotlini (današnji Šinjiang na Kitajskem). Starodavna prestolnica je sprva stala zahodno od današnjega Hotana v Jotkanu. Od dinastije Han vsaj do dinastije Tang so ga Kitajci imenovali Jutjan. To pretežno budistično kraljestvo je obstajalo več kot tisoč let, dokler ga leta 1006 med islamizacijo in turkizacijo Šinjianga ni osvojil muslimanski Karahanidski kanat.

source.title: Kingdom of Khotan
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Khotan, also called the Kingdom of Yutian (Chinese: 于闐), was an ancient Buddhist Saka kingdom located on the branch of the Silk Road that ran along the southern edge of the Taklamakan Desert in the Tarim Basin (modern-day Xinjiang, China). The ancient capital was originally sited to the west of modern-day Hotan at Yotkan. From the Han dynasty until at least the Tang dynasty it was known in Chinese as Yutian. This largely Buddhist kingdom existed for over a thousand years until it was conquered by the Muslim Kara-Khanid Khanate in 1006, during the Islamization and Turkicization of Xinjiang.

Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom.headline: Kušansko-sasanidsko kraljestvo
paragraphs: Kušansko-sasanidsko kraljestvo, znano tudi kot indo-sasanidsko kraljestvo, je Sasanidsko cesarstvo v 3. in 4. stoletju vzpostavilo v Baktriji. Sasanidsko cesarstvo je po vrsti vojn leta 225 n. št. propadajočemu Kušanskemu cesarstvu odvzelo province Sogdijano, Baktrijo in Gandharo. Tamkajšnji sasanidski upravitelji so nato prevzeli naslov kušanšah (v baktrijskem jeziku KΟÞANΟ ÞAΟ ali Koshano Shao), »kralj Kušanov«, in kovali denar. Včasih jih štejejo za »podkraljestvo« znotraj Sasanidskega cesarstva.

Ta uprava je trajala do let 360–370, ko so Kušano-Sasanidi velik del ozemlja izgubili proti Kidaritom, ki so vdrli v deželo, preostanek pa je Sasanidsko cesarstvo priključilo neposredno. Kidarite so pozneje izpodrinili Heftaliti.
Kušanšahe poznamo predvsem po kovancih. Kovali so jih v Kabulu, Balhu, Heratu in Mervu, kar priča o obsegu njihovega kraljestva.

source.title: Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom
paragraphs: The Kushano-Sasanian Kingdom also known as the Indo-Sasanian Kingdom was a polity established by the Sasanian Empire in Bactria during the 3rd and 4th centuries. The Sasanian Empire captured the provinces of Sogdia, Bactria and Gandhara from the declining Kushan Empire following a series of wars in 225 CE. The local Sasanian governors then went on to take the title of Kushanshah (KΟÞANΟ ÞAΟ or Koshano Shao in the Bactrian language) or "King of the Kushans", and to mint coins. They are sometimes considered as forming a "sub-kingdom" inside the Sasanian Empire.

This administration continued until 360–370, when the Kushano-Sasanians lost much of their domains to the invading Kidarites; the remainder was incorporated into the Sasanian Empire proper. Later, the Kidarites were in turn displaced by the Hephthalites.
The Kushanshahs are mainly known through their coins. Their coins were minted at Kabul, Balkh, Herat, and Merv, attesting the extent of their realm.

Lazica.headline: Lazika
paragraphs: Kraljestvo Lazika (gruzijsko: ეგრისი; lazijsko: ლაზიკა; starogrško: Λαζική), včasih imenovano Lazijsko cesarstvo, je bilo država na ozemlju zahodne Gruzije v rimskem obdobju, od približno 1. stoletja pr. n. št. Nastalo je, ko je razpadlo kraljestvo Kolhida in so plemenske ozemeljske enote v njem leta 131 n. št. dosegle neodvisnost.
notes: Izpuščene so latinične transliteracije gruzijskega, lazijskega in grškega imena.
Drugi stavek vira nima glavnega glagola; dopolnjen je po smislu. Vir postavlja začetek države v 1. stoletje pr. n. št., njeno nastanje pa v leto 131 n. št.; prevedeno je, kot stoji.

source.title: Lazica
paragraphs: The Kingdom of Lazica (Georgian: ეგრისი, romanized: Egrisi; Laz: ლაზიკა, romanized: Laziǩa; Ancient Greek: Λαζική, romanized: Lazikḗ), sometimes called Lazian Empire, was a state in the territory of west Georgia in the Roman period, from about the 1st century BC. Created as a result of the collapse of the kingdom of Colchis and the gaining of independence by the tribal-territorial units included in it in 131 AD.

Lohara dynasty.headline: Dinastija Lohara
paragraphs: Dinastija Lohara je od leta 1003 do približno 1175 vladala Kašmirju in okoliškim območjem na severozahodu Indijske podceline. Zgodnjo zgodovino dinastije opisuje Radžatarangini (»Kronika kraljev«), delo, ki ga je sredi 12. stoletja napisal Kalhana in na katerem temelji veliko raziskav o prvih 150 letih dinastije. Poznejša poročila, ki segajo do konca dinastije in čez, sta zapisala Džonaradža in Šrivara. Poznejše vladarje dinastije so imeli za šibke. V tem obdobju so bili pogosti notranji spori in korupcija, ki so jih le občasno prekinila kratka obdobja stabilnosti. Ti dejavniki so dinastijo naredili ranljivo za širjenje islamskih osvajanj v regiji.

source.title: Lohara dynasty
paragraphs: The Lohara dynasty was a dynasty that ruled over Kashmir and surrounding regions in the northwestern part of the Indian subcontinent between 1003 and approximately 1175. The early history of the dynasty was described in the Rajatarangini (Chronicle of Kings), a work written by Kalhana in the mid-12th century, upon which many studies of the first 150 years of the dynasty depend. Subsequent accounts which provide information up to and beyond the end of the dynasty come from Jonarāja and Śrīvara. The later rulers of the dynasty were perceived as weak. Internal conflicts and instances of corruption were prevalent during this era, occasionally interrupted by short periods of stability. These factors contributed to the dynasty's susceptibility to the expansion of Islamic conquests in the region.

Moghulistan.headline: Mogulistan
paragraphs: Mogulistan, imenovan tudi Mogulski kanat ali Vzhodni čagatajski kanat, je bil turško-mongolski muslimanski kanat, ki se je odcepil od Čagatajskega kanata, in zgodovinsko geografsko območje severno od gorovja Tengri Tag na meji med Srednjo in Vzhodno Azijo. Območje danes obsega dele Kazahstana, Kirgizistana in severozahodnega Šinjianga. Kanat je temu območju nominalno vladal od sredine 14. do konca 17. stoletja.

Od sredine 14. stoletja je v porečju reke Ili nastal nov kanat v obliki nomadske plemenske konfederacije, ki jo je vodil član Čagatajeve rodbine. Zato velja za nadaljevanje Čagatajskega kanata, imenujejo pa ga tudi Mogulski kanat.

source.title: Moghulistan
paragraphs: Moghulistan, also called the Moghul Khanate or the Eastern Chagatai Khanate, was a Turco-Mongol, Muslim, breakaway khanate of the Chagatai Khanate and a historical geographic area north of the Tengri Tagh mountain range, on the border of Central Asia and East Asia. That area today includes parts of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, and northwest Xinjiang. The khanate nominally ruled over the area from the mid-14th century until the late 17th century.

Beginning in the mid-14th century a new khanate, in the form of a nomadic tribal confederacy headed by a member of the family of Chagatai, arose in the region of the Ili River. It is therefore considered to be a continuation of the Chagatai Khanate, but it is also referred to as the Moghul Khanate.

Mongol invasion of Central Asia.headline: Mongolski pohodi v Srednji Aziji
paragraphs: Mongolsko cesarstvo je po združitvi mongolskih in turških plemen na Mongolski planoti leta 1206 izvedlo več pohodov v Srednji Aziji. Med manjše vojaške operacije sodita uničenje preživelih Merkitov in Najmanov (ki je vključevalo vpade v Kumanijo) in osvojitev Kara Kitaja. Sledil je velik pohod proti Horezmu. Širjenje v Srednjo Azijo se je začelo leta 1209, ko je Džingis-kan poslal odpravo, da bi zasledovala tekmece, ki so pobegnili v to območje in ogrožali njegovo novo cesarstvo. Ujgursko kraljestvo Kočo in voditelji Karlukov so se Mongolskemu cesarstvu podredili prostovoljno in se poročili v cesarsko družino. Do leta 1218 so Mongoli nadzorovali ves Šinjiang, do leta 1221 pa vsa ozemlja nekdanjega Horezmijskega cesarstva. Leta 1236 so Mongoli porazili vzhodne dele Kumanije in vdrli v vzhodno Evropo.
notes: Naslov »Mongol invasion of Central Asia« preusmeri na članek »Mongol campaigns in Central Asia«.

source.title: Mongol campaigns in Central Asia
paragraphs: The Mongol Empire conducted several campaigns in Central Asia after the unification of the Mongol and Turkic tribes on the Mongolian Plateau in 1206. Smaller military operations included the destruction of surviving Merkit and Naimans (which involved forays into Cumania) and the conquest of Qara Khitai. These were followed by a major campaign against Khwarazm. Expansion into Central Asia began in 1209 as Genghis Khan sent an expedition to pursue rivals who had fled to the region and threatened his new empire. The Uyghur kingdom Qocho and leaders of the Karluks submitted voluntarily to the Mongol Empire and married into the imperial family. By 1218 the Mongols controlled all of Xinjiang and by 1221 all the territories of the former Khwarazmian Empire. In 1236, the Mongols defeated the eastern portions of Cumania and swept into Eastern Europe.
Izraz mongolski kanat se lahko nanaša na:
kanat Hamag Mongol (10. stoletje–1206),
Mongolsko cesarstvo (1206–1368).
notes: Zapis je povezan z razločitveno stranjo; prevedeno je kot seznam, kot stoji.

source.title: Mongol khanate
paragraphs: Mongol khanate or Mongolian khanate can refer to:
Khanate of the Khamag Mongol (10th century–1206)
Mongol Empire (1206-1368)

Severni Juan je bil dinastična država, ki ji je vladal mongolski klan Bordžigin s središčem na Mongolski planoti. Obstajal je kot okrnjena država po propadu dinastije Juan leta 1368 in trajal do leta 1635, ko ga je osvojila pozna dinastija Džin pod vodstvom Džurčenov, pozneje preimenovana v dinastijo Čing. Dinastija Severni Juan se je začela z umikom juanskega cesarskega dvora pod vodstvom Togona Temürja (cesarja Huejcunga iz dinastije Juan) v mongolsko stepo. Obdobje so zaznamovali boji med frakcijami in pogosto le nominalna vloga velikega kana.

source.title: Northern Yuan
paragraphs: The Northern Yuan was a dynastic state ruled by the Mongol Borjigin clan based in the Mongolian Plateau. It existed as a rump state after the collapse of the Yuan dynasty in 1368 and lasted until its conquest by the Jurchen-led Later Jin dynasty in 1635, which was later renamed as the Qing dynasty. The Northern Yuan dynasty began with the retreat of the Yuan imperial court led by Toghon Temür (Emperor Huizong of Yuan) to the Mongolian steppe. This period featured factional struggles and the often only nominal role of the Great Khan.

Oghuz Khagan.headline: Oguz kagan
paragraphs: Oguz kagan ali Oguz kan (turško: Oğuz Kağan ali Oğuz Han; azerbajdžansko: Oğuz Xan ali Oğuz Xaqan; turkmensko: Oguz Han) je legendarni kan turških ljudstev in eponimni prednik oguških Turkov. Nekatere turške kulture z legendo o Oguz kanu opisujejo svoj etnični in plemenski izvor. Različice pripovedi, ohranjene v številnih rokopisih, so izšle v mnogih jezikih. Pripovedi o njem pogosto nosijo naslov Oguzname; obstaja več izročil, ki opisujejo njegove številne podvige in osvajanja, nekatera pa se prekrivajo z drugimi turškimi epskimi izročili, kot sta Seldžukname in Knjiga Dede Korkuta. Oguz kan je izhajal iz plemena Balga, bil je sin Kara Beja (Oguz Beja) in je pozneje postal kan.
notes: Izpuščena je napotitev na seznam virov (»as listed in the references below«).

source.title: Oghuz Khagan
paragraphs: Oghuz Khagan or Oğuz Khan (Turkish: Oğuz Kağan or Oğuz Han; Azerbaijani: Oğuz Xan or Oğuz Xaqan; Turkmen: Oguz Han) is a legendary khan of the Turkic people and an eponymous ancestor of the Oghuz Turks. Some Turkic cultures use the legend of Oghuz Khan to describe their ethnic and tribal origins.
