The various versions of the narrative preserved in many different manuscripts have been published in numerous languages, as listed in the references below. The narratives about him are often entitled Oghuzname, of which there are several traditions describing his many feats and conquests; some of these tend to overlap with other Turkic epic traditions, such as the Seljukname and The Book of Dede Korkut. Oğuz Khan was from the Balga tribe, the son of Qara Bey (Oğuz Bey), and later became a khan.

Oirat Confederation.headline: Ojratska konfederacija
paragraphs: Ojratska konfederacija ali Štirje Ojrati (pisna ojratščina: ᡑᡈᠷᡋᡈᠨᡆᡕᡅᠷᠠᡑ; mongolsko: Дөрвөн Ойрад; kitajsko: 四衛拉特), nekoč znana kot Elevti, je bila konfederacija ojratskih plemen, s katero so se v zgodovini Mongolske planote povzpeli zahodni Mongoli.

Čeprav vzhodni Mongoli in Ojrati izraz »Štirje Ojrati« splošno uporabljajo in so ga zgodovinarji že večkrat razlagali, o tem, katera so bila prvotna štiri plemena, ni soglasja. Splošno velja, da izraz označuje plemena Čoros, Torgut, Dörbet in Hošut, po eni od teorij pa Ojrati niso bili krvno sorodne enote, temveč politično-etnične enote iz številnih rodov po moški liniji. V zgodnjem obdobju je konfederaciji pripadalo tudi pleme Kergüd.
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi ojratskega in mongolskega imena ter izgovarjava (IPA).

source.title: Oirat Confederation
paragraphs: The Four Oirats (Written Oirat: ᡑᡈᠷᡋᡈᠨᡆᡕᡅᠷᠠᡑ, Dörbön Oyirad; Mongolian: Дөрвөн Ойрад, romanized: Dörvön Oirad, pronounced [ˈtɵrw̜ʊ̈ɴ ˈɞe̯ɾ(ə)t]; Chinese: 四衛拉特) or Oirat Confederation, formerly known as the Eleuths, was the confederation of the Oirat tribes which marked the rise of the Western Mongols in the history of the Mongolian Plateau.

Despite the universal currency of the term "Four Oirat" among Eastern Mongols, Oirats, and numerous explanations by historians, no consensus has been reached on the identity of the original four tribes. While it is believed that the term Four Oirats refers to the Choros, Torghut, Dörbet, and Khoshut tribes, there is a theory that the Oirats were not consanguineous units, but political-ethnic units composed of many patrilineages. In the early period, the Kergüd tribe also belonged to the confederation.

Ottoman–Persian War (1730–1735).headline: Osmansko-perzijska vojna (1730–1735)
paragraphs: Osmansko-perzijska vojna 1730–1735 je bila spopad med silami safavidskega Irana in Osmanskega cesarstva v letih 1730–1735. Ko osmanska podpora ni uspela obdržati gilzajskih afganistanskih zavojevalcev na iranskem prestolu, so bile osmanske posesti v zahodnem Iranu, ki jim jih je podelila dinastija Hotaki, v nevarnosti, da jih znova priključi obnovljeno Iransko cesarstvo. Nadarjeni safavidski general Nader je Osmanom postavil ultimat, naj se umaknejo, a so ga ti prezrli. Sledila je vrsta pohodov, v katerih je v pol desetletja burnih dogodkov zdaj ena zdaj druga stran dobivala premoč. Iranska zmaga pri Jeghevardu je Osmane nazadnje prisilila, da so zaprosili za mir ter priznali ozemeljsko celovitost Irana in iransko prevlado na Kavkazu.

source.title: Ottoman–Persian War (1730–1735)
paragraphs: The Ottoman–Persian War of 1730–1735 was a conflict between the forces of Safavid Iran and those of the Ottoman Empire from 1730 to 1735. After Ottoman support had failed to keep the Ghilzai Afghan invaders on the Iranian throne, the Ottoman possessions in western Iran, which were granted to them by the Hotak dynasty, came under risk of re-incorporation into the newly resurgent Iranian Empire. The talented Safavid general, Nader, gave the Ottomans an ultimatum to withdraw, which the Ottomans chose to ignore. A series of campaigns followed, with each side gaining the upper hand in a succession of tumultuous events that spanned half a decade. Finally, the Iranian victory at Yeghevard made the Ottomans sue for peace and recognize Iranian territorial integrity and Iranian hegemony over the Caucasus.

Tretja perzijsko-turška vojna (627–629) je bila zadnji spopad med Sasanidskim cesarstvom in Zahodnim turškim kaganatom. V nasprotju s prejšnjima vojnama se ni bila v Srednji Aziji, temveč v Zakavkazju. Sovražnosti sta leta 627 začela Tong Jabgu kagan zahodnih Göktürkov in bizantinski cesar Heraklij. Nasproti so jima stali sasanidski Perzijci, zavezniki Avarov.

source.title: Perso-Turkic war of 627–629
paragraphs: The Perso-Turkic war of 627–629 was the final conflict between the Sasanian Empire and the Western Turkic Khaganate. Unlike the previous two wars, it was not fought in Central Asia, but in Transcaucasia. Hostilities were initiated in 627 by Tong Yabghu Qaghan of the Western Göktürks and Emperor Heraclius of the Byzantine Empire. Opposing them were the Sassanid Persians, allied with the Avars.

Principality of Abkhazia.headline: Kneževina Abhazija
paragraphs: Kneževina Abhazija je nastala kot samostojna fevdalna tvorba v 15. in 16. stoletju sredi državljanskih vojn v Kraljestvu Gruziji, ki so se končale z razpadom enotne gruzijske monarhije. Kneževina je pod osmansko in nato rusko oblastjo ohranila nekaj avtonomije, vendar jo je Ruski imperij leta 1864 po kavkaški vojni dokončno priključil.

source.title: Principality of Abkhazia
paragraphs: The Principality of Abkhazia emerged as a separate feudal entity in the 15th–16th centuries, amid the civil wars in the Kingdom of Georgia that concluded with the dissolution of the unified Georgian monarchy. The principality retained a degree of autonomy under Ottoman and then Russian rule, but was eventually absorbed into the Russian Empire in 1864, following the Caucasian War.

Kneževina Gurija (gruzijsko: გურიის სამთავრო) je bila zgodovinska država v Gruziji. S središčem v današnji Guriji, jugozahodni gruzijski pokrajini, je ležala med Črnim morjem in Malim Kavkazom, od 1460. let do leta 1829 pa ji je vladalo dvaindvajset zaporednih knezov iz rodbine Gurieli. Kneževina je nastala med razpadanjem enotnega Kraljestva Gruzije. Njene meje so se spreminjale v nenehnih spopadih s sosednjimi gruzijskimi vladarji in Osmanskim cesarstvom, uživala pa je različno stopnjo avtonomije, dokler je leta 1829 ni priključila cesarska Rusija.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Principality of Guria
paragraphs: The Principality of Guria (Georgian: გურიის სამთავრო, romanized: guriis samtavro) was a historical state in Georgia. Centered on modern-day Guria, a southwestern region in Georgia, it was located between the Black Sea and Lesser Caucasus, and was ruled by a succession of twenty-two princes of the House of Gurieli from the 1460s to 1829. The principality emerged during the process of fragmentation of a unified Kingdom of Georgia. Its boundaries fluctuated in the course of permanent conflicts with neighboring Georgian rulers and the Ottoman Empire, and the principality enjoyed various degrees of autonomy until being annexed by Imperial Russia in 1829.

Iberska kneževina je bila zgodnjesrednjeveška aristokratska ureditev v osrednji gruzijski pokrajini Kartli, ki so jo antični avtorji imenovali Iberija. Razcvetela se je v obdobju medvladja med 6. in 9. stoletjem, ko so vodilno politično oblast izvajali zaporedni knezi. Kneževino so ustanovili kmalu po tem, ko so Sasanidi okoli leta 580 odpravili tamkajšnjo kraljevsko dinastijo Hosroidov; trajala je do leta 888, ko je član dinastije Bagrationi obnovil kraljevsko oblast. Njene meje so se močno spreminjale, saj so se iberski knezi v tem obdobju spopadali s Perzijci, Bizantinci, Hazari, Arabci in sosednjimi kavkaškimi vladarji.

source.title: Principality of Iberia
paragraphs: The Principality of Iberia was an early medieval aristocratic regime in a core Georgian region of Kartli, called Iberia by classical authors. It flourished in the period of interregnum between the sixth and ninth centuries, when the leading political authority was exercised by a succession of princes. The principality was established shortly after the Sassanid suppression of the local royal Chosroid dynasty, around 580; it lasted until 888, when the kingship was restored by a member of the Bagrationi dynasty. Its borders fluctuated greatly as the presiding princes of Iberia confronted the Persians, Byzantines, Khazars, Arabs, and neighboring Caucasian rulers throughout this period.
Kneževina Mingrelija (gruzijsko: სამეგრელოს სამთავრო), znana tudi kot Odiši in Samegrelo, je bila zgodovinska država v Gruziji, ki ji je vladala dinastija Dadiani.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Principality of Mingrelia
paragraphs: The Principality of Mingrelia (Georgian: სამეგრელოს სამთავრო, romanized: samegrelos samtavro), also known as Odishi and as Samegrelo, was a historical state in Georgia ruled by the Dadiani dynasty.

Kneževina Svaneti (gruzijsko: სვანეთის სამთავრო) je bila majhna kneževina (samtavro) v pokrajini Svaneti v gorovju Veliki Kavkaz, ki je nastala po razpadu Kraljestva Gruzije konec 15. stoletja. Zaporedoma sta ji vladali rodbini Gelovani in Dadeškeliani, leta 1858 pa so jo priključili Ruskemu imperiju.
notes: Izpuščena je latinična transliteracija gruzijskega imena.

source.title: Principality of Svaneti
paragraphs: The Principality of Svaneti (Georgian: სვანეთის სამთავრო, romanized: svanetis samtavro) was a small principality (samtavro) in the Svaneti region of the Greater Caucasus mountains that emerged following the breakup of the Kingdom of Georgia in the late 15th century. It was ruled successively by the houses of Gelovani and Dadeshkeliani, and was annexed to the Russian Empire in 1858.

Protectorate of the Western Regions.headline: Protektorat Zahodnih pokrajin
paragraphs: Protektorat Zahodnih pokrajin (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 西域都护府; tradicionalno kitajsko: 西域都護府), cesarska uprava v Zahodnih pokrajinah, je s presledki deloval pod kitajsko dinastijo Han in njenimi naslednicami od leta 59 ali 60 pr. n. št. do konca obdobja šestnajstih kraljestev leta 439 n. št. Zahodne pokrajine so območja zahodno od prelaza Jumen, zlasti Tarimska kotlina na jugu Šinjianga. Turško govoreča ljudstva so ta območja pozneje imenovala Altišahr (južni Šinjiang brez Džungarije). Izraz »zahodne pokrajine« so Kitajci uporabljali tudi širše za Srednjo Azijo.

Protektorat je bil prva neposredna oblast kitajske vlade na tem območju. Sestavljale so ga različne vazalne države in hanske garnizije pod oblastjo generalnega protektorja Zahodnih pokrajin, ki ga je imenoval hanski dvor.
notes: Izpuščena sta zapisa v pinjinu in po Wade-Gilesu.

source.title: Protectorate of the Western Regions
paragraphs: The Protectorate of the Western Regions (simplified Chinese: 西域都护府; traditional Chinese: 西域都護府; pinyin: Xīyù Dūhù Fǔ; Wade–Giles: Hsi1-yü4 Tu1-hu4 Fu3) was an imperial administration (a protectorate) situated in the Western Regions administered by Han dynasty China and its successors on and off from 59 or 60 BCE until the end of the Sixteen Kingdoms period in 439 AD. The "Western Regions" refers to areas west of Yumen Pass, especially the Tarim Basin in southern Xinjiang. These areas would later be termed Altishahr (southern Xinjiang, excluding Dzungaria) by Turkic-speaking peoples. The term "western regions" was also used by the Chinese more generally to refer to Central Asia.

The protectorate was the first direct rule by a Chinese government of the area. It consisted of various vassal states and Han garrisons placed under the authority of a protector-general of the Western Regions, who was appointed by the Han court.

Provisional Priamurye Government.headline: Začasna priamurska vlada
paragraphs: Začasna priamurska vlada (rusko: Приамурский земский край) je obstajala v Priamurju na ruskem Daljnem vzhodu od 27. maja 1921 do 16. junija 1923. Bila je zadnja enklava Ruske države v ruski državljanski vojni.

source.title: Provisional Priamurye Government
paragraphs: The Provisional Priamurye Government or Provisional Priamur Government (Russian: Приамурский земский край) existed in the region of Priamurye of the Russian Far East between May 27, 1921 and June 16, 1923. It was the last Russian State enclave during the Russian Civil War.

Revolution in the Kingdom of Poland.headline: Revolucija v Kraljevini Poljski
paragraphs: Velik del ruske revolucije leta 1905 se je odvil v ruskem delu razdeljene Poljske (v Kongresni Poljski oziroma Privislinskem kraju) in je trajal do leta 1907. To je bil največji val stavk in najširše emancipacijsko gibanje, kar jih je Poljska doživela do 1970. in 1980. let. Eden glavnih dogodkov tega obdobja je bila vstaja v Łódźu junija 1905. Ves ta čas je prihajalo do številnih manjših demonstracij in oboroženih spopadov med kmeti in delavci na eni ter oblastjo na drugi strani. Zahteve demonstrantov so vključevale izboljšanje delavskih življenjskih razmer in politične svoboščine, zlasti večjo avtonomijo Poljske. Zlasti leta 1905 je bila Poljska na robu nove vstaje, revolucije ali državljanske vojne. Nekateri poljski zgodovinarji dogodke tega obdobja štejejo celo za četrto poljsko vstajo proti Ruskemu imperiju.
notes: Napotitev »see Congress Poland and Privislinsky Krai« je vključena v stavek kot pojasnilo.

source.title: Revolution in the Kingdom of Poland
paragraphs: A major part of the Russian Revolution of 1905 took place in the Russian Partition of Poland and lasted until 1907 (see Congress Poland and Privislinsky Krai). It was the largest wave of strikes and widest emancipatory movement that Poland had ever seen until the 1970s and the 1980s. One of the major events of that period was the insurrection in Łódź in June 1905. Throughout that period, many smaller demonstrations and armed struggles between the peasants and workers on one side and the government on the other took place. The demands of the demonstrators included the improvement of the workers' living conditions, as well as political freedoms, particularly related to increased autonomy for Poland. Particularly in 1905, Poland was at the verge of a new uprising, revolution or civil war. Some Polish historians even consider the events of that period a fourth Polish uprising against the Russian Empire.

Vojna v Gorskem Karabahu leta 2020 ali druga vojna v Gorskem Karabahu je bila oborožen spopad leta 2020 na spornem območju Gorskega Karabaha in okoliških zasedenih ozemljih. Bila je velika zaostritev nerazrešenega spora o regiji, v katerega so vpleteni Azerbajdžan, Armenija in samooklicana armenska odcepljena država Arcah. Vojna je trajala 44 dni in se končala z azerbajdžansko zmago, poraz pa je v Armeniji sprožil protivladne proteste. Spopadi so se v regiji nadaljevali tudi po vojni, med njimi obsežni spopadi leta 2022.

Boji so se začeli zjutraj 27. septembra z azerbajdžansko ofenzivo vzdolž ločnice, vzpostavljene po prvi vojni v Gorskem Karabahu (1988–1994). Spopadi so bili posebej hudi v manj goratih okrajih južnega Gorskega Karabaha. Turčija je Azerbajdžanu zagotavljala vojaško podporo.

source.title: Second Nagorno-Karabakh War
paragraphs: The Second Nagorno-Karabakh War was an armed conflict in 2020 that took place in the disputed region of Nagorno-Karabakh and the surrounding occupied territories. It was a major escalation of an unresolved conflict over the region, involving Azerbaijan, Armenia and the self-declared Armenian breakaway state of Artsakh. The war lasted for 44 days and resulted in Azerbaijani victory, with the defeat igniting anti-government protests in Armenia. Post-war skirmishes continued in the region, including substantial clashes in 2022.

Fighting began on the morning of 27 September, with an Azerbaijani offensive along the line of contact established in the aftermath of the First Nagorno-Karabakh War (1988–1994). Clashes were particularly intense in the less mountainous districts of southern Nagorno-Karabakh. Turkey provided military support to Azerbaijan.

Širvan (perzijsko: شروان ali شیروان; azerbajdžansko in tatsko: Şirvan) je zgodovinska iranska pokrajina na vzhodnem Kavkazu, kot je bila znana v predislamskem sasanidskem in zgodnjem islamskem obdobju. Danes je pokrajina industrijsko in kmetijsko razvit del Republike Azerbajdžan med zahodno obalo Kaspijskega jezera in reko Kuro s središčem na Širvanski ravnini.
notes: Izpuščeni so latinični zapisi klasične in iranske perzijske oblike imena; perzijska pisava ostaja.

source.title: Shirvan
paragraphs: Shirvan (from Classical Persian شروان Shirwān or شیروان Shīrwān [Iranian Persian: شروان Shervân or شیروان Shirvân]; Azerbaijani: Şirvan; Tat: Şirvan) is a historical Iranian region in the eastern Caucasus, as known both during the pre-Islamic Sasanian Era and the early Islamic period. Today, the region is an industrially and agriculturally developed part of the Republic of Azerbaijan that stretches between the western shores of the Caspian Sea and the Kura River, centered on the Shirvan Plain.

Siege of Bukhara.headline: Obleganje Buhare
paragraphs: Obleganje Buhare je potekalo februarja 1220 med mongolsko invazijo na Horezmijsko cesarstvo. Džingis-kan, vladar Mongolskega cesarstva, je sprožil napad iz več smeri na Horezmijsko cesarstvo, ki mu je vladal šah Mohamed II. Medtem ko je šah nameraval večja mesta braniti vsako posebej, so Mongoli oblegali obmejno mesto Otrar in prodrli globlje v Horezm.

Buhara je bila pomembno trgovsko in kulturno središče Horezmijskega cesarstva, vendar je ležala daleč od meje z Mongolskim cesarstvom, zato je šah za njeno obrambo namenil manj kot 20.000 vojakov. Mongolska vojska, ki je po ocenah štela od 30.000 do 50.000 mož in ji je poveljeval sam Džingis-kan, je prečkala puščavo Kizilkum, ki so jo dotlej imeli za neprehodno za velike vojske. Branilce Buhare je to presenetilo in po neuspelem izpadu se je zunanje mesto v treh dneh, 10. februarja, predalo. Horezmijski zvestobniki so citadelo branili še manj kot dva tedna, nato pa so jo prebili in zavzeli.

source.title: Siege of Bukhara
paragraphs: The siege of Bukhara took place in February 1220, during the Mongol invasion of the Khwarazmian Empire. Genghis Khan, ruler of the Mongol Empire, had launched a multi-pronged assault on the Khwarazmian Empire ruled by Shah Muhammad II. While the Shah planned to defend his major cities individually, the Mongols laid siege to the border town of Otrar, and struck further into Khwarazmia.

The city of Bukhara was a major centre of trade and culture in the Khwarazmian Empire, but was located far from the border with the Mongol Empire, and so the Shah had allocated fewer than 20,000 soldiers to defend it. A Mongol force, estimated to number between 30,000 and 50,000 men and commanded by Genghis himself, traversed the Kyzylkum Desert, previously considered impassable for large armies. Bukhara's defenders were caught by surprise and, after a failed sortie, the outer city surrendered within three days on 10 February. Khwarazmian loyalists continued to defend the citadel for less than two weeks, before it was breached and taken.

Siege of Petropavlovsk.headline: Obleganje Petropavlovska
paragraphs: Med obleganjem Petropavlovska, vojaško operacijo na pacifiškem bojišču krimske vojne, so britanske in francoske pomorske sile neuspešno poskušale zavzeti rusko pristanišče Petropavlovsk na polotoku Kamčatka. Ruske izgube ocenjujejo na 115 ubitih in hudo ranjenih vojakov in mornarjev, Britanci so imeli 105 žrtev, Francozi pa 104 (po uradnih ocenah zaveznikov).

source.title: Siege of Petropavlovsk
paragraphs: The Siege of Petropavlovsk was a military operation in the Pacific theatre of the Crimean War in which British and French naval forces unsuccessfully attempted to capture the Russian port of Petropavlovsk on the Kamchatka peninsula. The Russian casualties are estimated at 115 soldiers and sailors killed and seriously wounded, whilst the British suffered 105 casualties and the French 104 (by official estimates of the Allies).

Siege of the Sogdian Rock.headline: Obleganje Sogdijske skale
paragraphs: Sogdijsko skalo ali Ariamazovo skalo, trdnjavo severno od Baktrije v Sogdijani (blizu Samarkanda), ki ji je vladal Arimaz, so sile Aleksandra Velikega zgodaj spomladi leta 327 pr. n. št. zavzele med osvajanjem Ahemenidskega cesarstva.

source.title: Siege of the Sogdian Rock
paragraphs: The Sogdian Rock or Rock of Ariamazes, a fortress located north of Bactria in Sogdiana (near Samarkand), ruled by Arimazes, was captured by the forces of Alexander the Great in the early spring of 327 BC as part of his conquest of the Achaemenid Empire.

Vojna v Južni Osetiji 1991–1992 (znana tudi kot prva južnoosetijska vojna) se je bila med gruzijskimi vladnimi silami in etničnimi gruzijskimi milicami na eni strani ter silami južnoosetijskih separatistov in Rusijo na drugi. Končala se je s sporazumom iz Dagomisa, podpisanim 24. junija 1992, ki je vzpostavil skupne mirovne sile, Južna Osetija pa je ostala razdeljena med tekmujoči oblasti.

source.title: South Ossetia war (1991–1992)
paragraphs: The 1991–1992 South Ossetia War (also known as the First South Ossetia War) was fought between Georgian government forces and ethnic Georgian militias on one side and the forces of South Ossetian separatists and Russia on the other. The war ended with a Dagomys Agreement, signed on 24 June 1992, which established a joint peacekeeping force and left South Ossetia divided between the rival authorities.

Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Azerbajdžan
paragraphs: Invazija Rdeče armade na Azerbajdžan, znana tudi kot sovjetizacija ali sovjetska invazija na Azerbajdžan, je potekala aprila 1920. Bila je vojaški pohod 11. armade Sovjetske Rusije, katerega cilj je bil v Azerbajdžanski demokratični republiki vzpostaviti sovjetsko vlado. Invazija je sovpadla s protivladno vstajo, ki so jo v prestolnici Baku organizirali tamkajšnji azerbajdžanski boljševiki. Azerbajdžanska demokratična republika je zato razpadla, namesto nje pa so ustanovili Azerbajdžansko sovjetsko socialistično republiko.

V letih 1919–1920 je Azerbajdžan zajela huda politična ter družbena in gospodarska kriza, notranje razmere pa so bile nestabilne. Po vsej državi so izbruhali oboroženi spopadi med različnimi političnimi in družbenimi frakcijami. Po propadu republikanske oblasti leta 1918 so delovale podtalne organizacije različnih političnih strank in socialističnih skupin. Februarja 1920 so se te frakcije združile z Azerbajdžansko komunistično partijo (boljševikov), da bi uskladile politične cilje.

source.title: Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan
paragraphs: The Red Army invasion of Azerbaijan, also known as the Sovietization or Soviet invasion of Azerbaijan, took place in April 1920. It was a military campaign conducted by the 11th Army of the Soviet Russia aimed at installing a Soviet government in the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic. The invasion coincided with an anti-government insurrection organized by local Azerbaijani Bolsheviks in the capital city of Baku. As a result, the Azerbaijan Democratic Republic was dissolved, and the Azerbaijan Soviet Socialist Republic was established.

During 1919–1920, Azerbaijan experienced severe political and socio-economic crises, with volatile internal conditions. Armed conflicts occurred between various political and social factions across the country. Since the collapse of Republican Power in 1918, underground organizations consisting of different political parties and socialist groups were active. These factions united with the AC(b)P in February 1920 to coordinate their political objectives.

Soviet invasion of Georgia.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Gruzijo
paragraphs: Sovjetska invazija na Gruzijo (12. februar – 17. marec 1921), znana tudi kot gruzijsko-sovjetska vojna ali invazija Rdeče armade na Gruzijo, je bila vojaški pohod ruske sovjetske Rdeče armade, katerega cilj je bil strmoglaviti socialdemokratsko (menjševiško) vlado Demokratične republike Gruzije (DRG) in v državi vzpostaviti boljševiški režim (Komunistično partijo Gruzije). Spopad je bil posledica ekspanzionistične politike boljševikov, ki so hoteli nadzorovati čim več dežel, ki so do burnih dogodkov prve svetovne vojne pripadale nekdanjemu Ruskemu imperiju, in revolucionarnih prizadevanj gruzijskih boljševikov, ki so večinoma delovali v Rusiji in v domovini niso imeli dovolj podpore, da bi brez posredovanja od zunaj prevzeli oblast.

source.title: Soviet invasion of Georgia
paragraphs: The Soviet invasion of Georgia (12 February – 17 March 1921), also known as the Georgian–Soviet War or the Red Army invasion of Georgia, was a military campaign by the Russian Soviet Red Army aimed at overthrowing the Social Democratic (Menshevik) government of the Democratic Republic of Georgia (DRG) and installing a Bolshevik regime (Communist Party of Georgia) in the country. The conflict was a result of expansionist policy by the Bolsheviks, who aimed to control as much as possible of the lands which had been part of the former Russian Empire until the turbulent events of the First World War, as well as the revolutionary efforts of mostly Russian-based Georgian Bolsheviks, who did not have sufficient support in their native country to seize power without external intervention.

Soviet invasion of South Sakhalin.headline: Sovjetska invazija na Južni Sahalin
paragraphs: Sovjetska zveza je vdrla v japonski del otoka Sahalin, znan tudi kot prefektura Karafuto. Invazija je bila del sovjetsko-japonske vojne, manjšega pohoda na azijskem bojišču druge svetovne vojne.

source.title: Soviet invasion of South Sakhalin
paragraphs: The Soviet Union invaded the Japanese portion of Sakhalin Island, also known as Karafuto Prefecture. The invasion was part of the Soviet–Japanese War, a minor campaign in the Asian theatre during World War II.

Swedish invasion of Russia.headline: Švedska invazija na Rusijo
paragraphs: Švedska invazija na Rusijo, znana tudi kot ruski pohod ali poltavski pohod švedskega kralja Karla XII., je potekala od januarja 1708 do julija 1709 med veliko severno vojno. Pohod se je začel 1. januarja 1708, ko je Karel prečkal Vislo, dejansko pa se je končal s švedskim porazom v bitki pri Poltavi 8. julija 1709, ki mu je 11. julija 1709 sledila švedska vdaja pri Perevoločni. Čeprav je Karel pod zaščito Osmanskega cesarstva še več let vojaško ogrožal Rusijo, je bil 18-mesečni pohod prelomnica vse vojne.

source.title: Swedish invasion of Russia
paragraphs: The Swedish invasion of Russia, also known as the Russian campaign, or Poltava campaign of Charles XII of Sweden, was undertaken from January 1708 to July 1709 during the Great Northern War. The campaign began with Charles's crossing of the Vistula on 1 January 1708, and effectively ended with the Swedish defeat in the Battle of Poltava on 8 July 1709, after which the Swedish surrender at Perevolochna occurred on 11 July 1709. Though Charles continued to pose a military threat to Russia for several years while under the protection of the Ottoman Empire, the 18-month campaign was a turning point in the overall war.

Tadžikistanska državljanska vojna je bila oborožen spopad v Tadžikistanu, ki se je začel maja 1992 in končal junija 1997. Regionalne skupine iz tadžikistanskih pokrajin Garm in Gorski Badahšan so se uprle novi vladi predsednika Rahmona Nabijeva, v kateri so prevladovali ljudje iz pokrajin Hudžand in Kulob. Uporniške skupine so vodili liberalno-demokratični reformatorji in islamisti, ki so se pozneje združili v Združeno tadžikistansko opozicijo. Vlado so podpirali ruska vojska in mejni stražarji.

source.title: Tajikistani Civil War
paragraphs: The Tajikistani Civil War was an armed conflict in Tajikistan that began in May 1992 and ended in June 1997. Regional groups from the Garm and Gorno-Badakhshan regions of Tajikistan rose up against the newly formed government of President Rahmon Nabiyev, which was dominated by people from the Khujand and Kulob regions. The rebel groups were led by a combination of liberal democratic reformers and Islamists, who would later organize under the banner of the United Tajik Opposition. The government was supported by Russian military and border guards.

Tashkent Declaration.headline: Taškentska deklaracija
paragraphs: Taškentsko deklaracijo sta Indija in Pakistan podpisala 10. januarja 1966, da bi razrešila drugo indijsko-pakistansko vojno (1965). Mir so dosegli 23. septembra s posredovanjem Sovjetske zveze in Združenih držav, ki sta sprti državi potisnili k premirju, da bi preprečili zaostritev, v katero bi se lahko vpletle še druge sile.

source.title: Tashkent Declaration
paragraphs: The Tashkent Declaration was signed between India and Pakistan on 10 January 1966 to resolve the Indo-Pakistani War of 1965. Peace was achieved on 23 September through interventions by the Soviet Union and the United States, both of which pushed the two warring countries towards a ceasefire in an attempt to avoid any escalation that could draw in other powers.

Tibetanski imperij (tibetansko: བོད་ཆེན་པོ, dobesedno »Veliki Tibet«) je imel središče na Tibetanski planoti in je nastal v 7. stoletju z osvajanji pod Songcenom Gampom, 33. kraljem dinastije Jarlung. Še bolj se je razširil pod Trisongom Decenom, največji obseg pa je dosegel pod Tricugom Decenom, ko je segal na vzhodu do Čang'ana, na zahodu čez današnji Afganistan, na jugu pa v današnjo Indijo in do Bengalskega zaliva. Kitajski viri ga imenujejo Tufan ali Tubo (吐蕃).
notes: Izpuščena je transliteracija po Wylieju.

source.title: Tibetan Empire
paragraphs: The Tibetan Empire (Tibetan: བོད་ཆེན་པོ, Wylie: bod chen po, lit. 'Great Tibet') was centered on the Tibetan Plateau and formed as a result of expansions under the Yarlung dynasty's 33rd king, Songtsen Gampo, in the 7th century. It expanded further under Trisong Detsen and reached its greatest extent under Tritsuk Detsen, stretching east to Chang'an, west beyond modern Afghanistan, south into modern India and the Bay of Bengal. It is referred to as Tufan or Tubo (吐蕃) in Chinese sources.

Treaty of Aigun.headline: Ajgunska pogodba
paragraphs: Ajgunska pogodba je bila pogodba med Ruskim imperijem in kitajsko dinastijo Čing iz leta 1858. V imenu Činga jo je podpisal čingovski uradnik Jišan. Določila je velik del današnje meje med ruskim Daljnim vzhodom in Kitajsko, saj je Kitajska z njo odstopila velik del Mandžurije (pradomovine Mandžurov), danes znane kot Severovzhodna Kitajska. Pogajanja so se začela, ko je generalni guverner Daljnega vzhoda Nikolaj Muravjov Kitajski zagrozil z vojno na drugi fronti, medtem ko je ta zatirala tajpinški upor. Pogodba je razveljavila mir v Nerčinsku (1689), saj je ozemlje med gorovjem Stanovoj in reko Amur prenesla z dinastije Čing na Ruski imperij. Rusija je dobila več kot 600.000 kvadratnih kilometrov ozemlja, ki so ga začeli imenovati Zunanja Mandžurija. Čingovska vlada sprva ni hotela priznati veljavnosti pogodbe, vendar so ruske pridobitve iz Ajgunske pogodbe potrdili s kitajsko-rusko pekinško konvencijo leta 1860.
notes: Izpuščena je pretvorba v kvadratne milje.

source.title: Treaty of Aigun
paragraphs: The Treaty of Aigun was an 1858 treaty between the Russian Empire and Qing dynasty of China. Yishan, official of the Qing, signed it on behalf of the Qing. It established much of the modern border between the Russian Far East and China by ceding much of Manchuria (the ancestral homeland of the Manchu people), now known as Northeast China. Negotiations began after China was threatened with war on a second front by Governor-General of the Far East Nikolay Muraviev when China was suppressing the Taiping Rebellion. It reversed the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689) by transferring the land between the Stanovoy Range and the Amur River from the Qing dynasty to the Russian Empire. Russia received over 600,000 square kilometers (231,660 sq mi) of what became known as Outer Manchuria. While the Qing government initially refused to recognize the validity of the treaty, the Russian gains under the Treaty of Aigun were affirmed as part of the 1860 Sino-Russian Convention of Peking.

Treaty of Kyakhta (1727).headline: Kjahtinska pogodba (1727)
paragraphs: Kjahtinska pogodba (tudi Kiakhta) je skupaj z mirom v Nerčinsku (1689) do sredine 19. stoletja urejala odnose med carsko Rusijo in čingovskim cesarstvom Kitajske. Podpisala sta jo Tulišen in grof Sava Lukič Raguzinski-Vladislavič 23. avgusta 1727 v obmejnem mestu Kjahta.

source.title: Treaty of Kyakhta (1727)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Kyakhta (or Kiakhta), along with the Treaty of Nerchinsk (1689), regulated the relations between Imperial Russia and the Qing Empire of China until the mid-19th century. It was signed by Tulišen and Count Sava Lukich Raguzinskii-Vladislavich at the border city of Kyakhta on 23 August 1727.

Treaty of Kyakhta (1915).headline: Kjahtinska pogodba (1915)
paragraphs: Kjahtinska pogodba (mongolsko: Хиагтын гэрээ; rusko: Кяхтинский договор; kitajsko: 中俄蒙協約) je bila tristranska pogodba, ki so jo 25. maja 1915 podpisale Rusija, Mongolija in Kitajska.

Rusija in Kitajska sta priznali avtonomijo Zunanje Mongolije (kot dela kitajskega ozemlja), Mongolija je priznala kitajsko suzerenost, z drugimi državami pa ni smela sklepati mednarodnih pogodb o političnih in ozemeljskih vprašanjih.

Mongolski predstavnik, predsednik vlade Tögs-Očirijn Namnansüren, je bil odločen avtonomijo razširiti v dejansko neodvisnost in Kitajcem priznati le nejasna, neučinkovita suzerenska pooblastila. Kitajci so si prizadevali mongolsko avtonomijo čim bolj omejiti, če ne celo odpraviti.

source.title: Treaty of Kyakhta (1915)
paragraphs: The Treaty of Kyakhta (Mongolian: Хиагтын гэрээ; Russian: Кяхтинский договор; Chinese: 中俄蒙協約) was a tri-party treaty signed on 25 May 1915 among Russia, Mongolia, and China.

Russia and China recognized Outer Mongolia's autonomy (as part of Chinese territory); Mongolia recognized China's suzerainty; Mongolia could not conclude international treaties with foreign countries regarding political and territorial questions.

The Mongolian representative, Prime Minister Tögs-Ochiryn Namnansüren, was determined to stretch autonomy into de facto independence, and to deny the Chinese anything more than vague, ineffectual suzerain powers. The Chinese sought to minimize, if not to end, Mongolian autonomy.

Treaty of Nerchinsk.headline: Mir v Nerčinsku
paragraphs: Mir v Nerčinsku je bil mirovni sporazum med Ruskim carstvom in dinastijo Čing, sklenjen po ruskem porazu pri obleganju Albazina. Podpisala sta ga 27. avgusta 1689 Songgotu v imenu cesarja Kangšija in Fjodor Golovin v imenu ruskih carjev Petra I. in Ivana V.; to je bila prva uradna pogodba, ki jo je Kitajska kdaj sklenila z zahodno silo. Da bi se izognili težavam s prevodi in napačnim razlagam, so veljavno različico napisali v latinščini, drugotna prevoda pa v ruščini in mandžurščini. Uradnega kitajskega besedila še dve stoletji ni bilo, so pa mejnike popisali v kitajščini, mandžurščini, ruščini in latinščini.

source.title: Treaty of Nerchinsk
paragraphs: The Treaty of Nerchinsk was a peace treaty signed between the Tsardom of Russia and the Qing dynasty following Russia's defeat at the Siege of Albazin. Signed on 27 August 1689 by Songgotu on behalf of the Kangxi Emperor and Fyodor Golovin for Russian Tsars Peter I and Ivan V, it was the first formal treaty China ever signed with a Western power. To bypass translation issues and avoid misinterpretation, the authoritative version was written in Latin, with secondary translations made into Russian and Manchu. While no official Chinese text existed for another two centuries, physical border markers were inscribed in Chinese, Manchu, Russian, and Latin.

Tulip Revolution.headline: Tulipanova revolucija
paragraphs: Tulipanova revolucija, znana tudi kot prva kirgiška revolucija, je privedla do padca tedanjega kirgiškega predsednika Askarja Akajeva. Revolucija se je začela po parlamentarnih volitvah 27. februarja in 13. marca 2005. Revolucionarji so Akajeva, njegovo družino in privržence obtoževali korupcije in avtoritarnosti. Akajev je pobegnil v Kazahstan in nato v Rusijo. Na kirgiškem veleposlaništvu v Moskvi je 4. aprila 2005 v navzočnosti delegacije kirgiškega parlamenta podpisal odstopno izjavo. Kirgiški začasni parlament je odstop potrdil 11. aprila 2005.

source.title: Tulip Revolution
paragraphs: The Tulip Revolution, also known as the First Kyrgyz Revolution, led to Kyrgyzstan's then-President Askar Akayev's fall from power. The revolution began after parliamentary elections on 27 February and 13 March 2005. The revolutionaries alleged corruption and authoritarianism by Akayev, his family and supporters. Akayev fled to Kazakhstan and then to Russia. On 4 April 2005, at the Kyrgyz embassy in Moscow, Akayev signed his resignation statement in the presence of a Kyrgyz parliamentary delegation. The resignation was ratified by the Kyrgyz interim parliament on 11 April 2005.

Tumed.headline: Tümedi
paragraphs: Tümedi so mongolska podskupina. Živijo predvsem na območju okoli mesta Hohhot, denimo v praporih Levi Tumed in Desni Tumed (v Baotouju) na Kitajskem. Večinoma se ukvarjajo s stalnim poljedelstvom v mešanih skupnostih. Druga skupina Tümedov živi v Čaojangu v provinci Liaoning. Manjše število Tümedov živi v ajmagu Ömnögovi v Mongoliji.

Od začetka 9. do začetka 13. stoletja so Hori-Tümedi živeli ob zahodni strani Bajkalskega jezera, na območju današnje južne Irkutske oblasti, v delih Tuve in na jugozahodu Burjatije. Džingis-kan je leta 1207 po osvojitvi Hori-Tümedov sklenil nekatere od teh skupin preseliti na jug, kjer so se nazadnje naselili v južnih delih velike puščave Gobi.

source.title: Tumed
paragraphs: The Tümed are a Mongol subgroup. Tümed Mongols mainly live in the region around the city of Hohhot, such as Tumed Left Banner and Tumed Right Banner (in Baotou) in China. Most engage in sedentary agriculture in mixed communities. Another Tümed group live in Chaoyang, Liaoning. There are a small number of Tümeds in Ömnögovi Aimag, Mongolia.

From the beginning of the 9th century to the beginning of the 13th century, the Khori-Tumed lived near the western side of Lake Baikal. They lived in what is now southern Irkutsk Oblast, in some parts of Tuva and in southwestern Buryatia. In 1207, Genghis Khan, after conquering the Khori-Tumed, decided to move some of these groups south and these people eventually settled in the southern parts of the Great Gobi Desert.

Turško-armenska vojna ali turška invazija na Armenijo, v Turčiji znana kot vzhodna fronta (turško: Doğu cephesi) turške vojne za neodvisnost, je bila spopad med novoustanovljeno Prvo republiko Armenijo in turškim nacionalnim gibanjem po podpisu Sevreške mirovne pogodbe leta 1920. Pogodba je Armeniji dodelila velik del vzhodne Anatolije, ki je pripadal Osmanskemu cesarstvu, vključno z mesti Trabzon, Erzurum in Van. Odposlanci osmanske vlade so pogodbo po porazu v prvi svetovni vojni nejevoljno podpisali, poslanci osmanskega parlamenta pa je niso hoteli ratificirati. Pogodba je močno razjezila turške nacionaliste pod vodstvom Mustafe Kemala paše, ki je niso hoteli priznati. Septembra 1920 so ostanki XV. korpusa osmanske vojske pod poveljstvom Kâzıma Karabekirja napadli Zahodno Armenijo z neposrednim ukazom Mustafe Kemala (Atatürka), naj »Armenijo fizično in politično odstranijo«.

source.title: Turkish invasion of Armenia
paragraphs: The Turkish invasion of Armenia, also known as the Turkish–Armenian War and known in Turkey as the Eastern Front (Turkish: Doğu cephesi) of the Turkish War of Independence, was a conflict fought between the recently established First Republic of Armenia and the Turkish National Movement, following the signing of the Treaty of Sèvres in 1920. The treaty transferred vast portions of eastern Anatolia from the Ottoman Empire to Armenia, including the towns of Trabzon, Erzurum and Van. While delegates of the Ottoman government reluctantly signed the treaty following their defeat in World War I, members of the Ottoman parliament refused to ratify it. The treaty greatly angered the Turkish Nationalists, led by Mustafa Kemal Pasha, who refused to recognize it. In September 1920, remnants of the Ottoman Army's XV Corps under the command of Kâzım Karabekir, attacked Western Armenia with direct orders from Mustafa Kemal (Atatürk) to "eliminate Armenia physically and politically".

Utpala dynasty.headline: Dinastija Utpala
paragraphs: Dinastija Utpala je bila srednjeveška kašmirska hindujska dinastija, ki je Kašmirju vladala od 9. do 10. stoletja. Ustanovil jo je Avantivarman leta 855, nadomestila pa je dinastijo Karkota. Nastala je na severu Indijske podceline. Med njeno vladavino so ustanovili mesti Avantipur (Avantipora) in Sujapur (Sopore) ter zgradili številne hindujske templje, posvečene Višnuju in Šivi, in budistične samostane, med katerimi izstopata templja Avantišvara in Avantisvami.

source.title: Utpala dynasty
paragraphs: The Utpala Dynasty was a medieval Kashmiri Hindu dynasty that ruled over Kashmir from the 9th to 10th centuries. Founded by Avantivarman in 855, it replaced the Karkota dynasty. It came into existence in the northern region of the Indian subcontinent. The cities of Avantipur (Awantipora) and Suyapur (Sopore) were founded during the reign, and many Hindu temples dedicated to both Vishnu and Shiva, and Buddhist monasteries were built, notable of which is the Avantiswara and Avantiswami temples.

War of the Heavenly Horses.headline: Vojna za nebeške konje
paragraphs: Vojna za nebeške konje (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 天马之战; tradicionalno kitajsko: 天馬之戰) ali hansko-dajuanska vojna (poenostavljeno kitajsko: 汉宛战争; tradicionalno kitajsko: 漢宛戰爭) je bila vojaški spopad, ki se je v letih 104 in 102 pr. n. št. bil med kitajsko dinastijo Han in kraljestvom Dajuan v Ferganski dolini na skrajnem vzhodnem robu nekdanjega Aleksandrovega imperija (med današnjim Uzbekistanom, Kirgizistanom in Tadžikistanom). Vojno naj bi sprožili trgovinski spori, ki jih je zaostrila širša geopolitika hansko-šiungnujskih vojn; dinastija Han je poslala dva pohoda, ki sta se končala s hansko zmago, zato je lahko svojo prevlado razširila globoko v Srednjo Azijo (Kitajci so jo tedaj imenovali Zahodne pokrajine).
notes: Izpuščen je zapis v pinjinu.

source.title: War of the Heavenly Horses
paragraphs: The War of the Heavenly Horses (simplified Chinese: 天马之战; traditional Chinese: 天馬之戰; pinyin: Tiānmǎ zhī Zhàn) or the Han–Dayuan War (simplified Chinese: 汉宛战争; traditional Chinese: 漢宛戰爭; pinyin: Hàn Yuān Zhànzhēng) was a military conflict fought in 104 BC and 102 BC between the Chinese Han dynasty and the kingdom of Dayuan, in the Ferghana Valley at the easternmost end of the former Alexander's empire (between modern-day Uzbekistan, Kyrgyzstan and Tajikistan). The war was allegedly instigated by trade disputes compounded by the extended geopolitics surrounding the Han-Xiongnu Wars, resulting in two Han expeditions that ended in a Han victory, allowing the Han dynasty to expand its hegemony deep into Central Asia (then known to the Chinese as the Western Regions).

Wusun.headline: Usuni
paragraphs: Usuni so bili starodavno polnomadsko stepsko ljudstvo, ki ga kitajski zapisi omenjajo od 2. stoletja pr. n. št. do 5. stoletja n. št.

Usuni so sprva živeli med gorovjem Čilian in Dunhuangom (Gansu) v bližini Jüedžijev. Okoli leta 176 pr. n. št. je ljudstvo Šiungnu napadlo dežele Jüedžijev, ti pa so nato napadli Usune, ubili njihovega kralja in jim vzeli zemljo. Šiungnu so posvojili preživelega usunskega princa in ga postavili za enega svojih generalov in voditelja Usunov. Okoli leta 162 pr. n. št. so bili Jüedžiji pregnani v dolino reke Ili v Žetisuju, Džungariji in Tjanšanu, kjer so prej živeli Saki. Usuni so se nato kot vazali ljudstva Šiungnu znova naselili v Gansuju. V letih 133–132 pr. n. št. so Usuni pregnali Jüedžije iz doline Ili in se tam naselili.

Usuni so nato postali tesni zavezniki dinastije Han in več stoletij ostali močna sila v regiji. Kitajci jih nazadnje omenjajo v 5. stoletju n. št., ko so se zaradi pritiska Rouranov naselili v Pamirju. Morda so se pozneje vključili med Heftalite.
notes: Izpuščen je angleški zapis izgovarjave.

source.title: Wusun
paragraphs: The Wusun ( WOO-sun) were an ancient semi-nomadic steppe people mentioned in Chinese records from the 2nd century BC to the 5th century AD.

The Wusun originally lived between the Qilian Mountains and Dunhuang (Gansu) near the Yuezhi. Around 176 BC the Xiongnu raided the lands of the Yuezhi, who subsequently attacked the Wusun, killing their king and seizing their land. The Xiongnu adopted the surviving Wusun prince and made him one of their generals and leader of the Wusun. Around 162 BC the Yuezhi were driven into the Ili River Valley in Zhetysu, Dzungaria and Tian Shan, which had formerly been inhabited by the Saka. The Wusun then resettled in Gansu as vassals of the Xiongnu. In 133–132 BC, the Wusun drove the Yuezhi out of the Ili Valley and settled the area.

The Wusun then became close allies of the Han dynasty and remained a powerful force in the region for several centuries. The Wusun are last mentioned by the Chinese as having settled in the Pamir Mountains in the 5th century AD due to pressure from the Rouran. They possibly became subsumed into the later Hephthalites.

Dinastija Juan, uradno Veliki Juan, je bila cesarska dinastija Kitajske pod vodstvom Mongolov in naslednica Mongolskega cesarstva po njegovi razdelitvi. Ustanovil jo je Kublaj (cesar Šidzu ali Secen kan), peti kagan-cesar Mongolskega cesarstva iz klana Bordžigin, trajala pa je od leta 1271 do 1368 n. št. V kitajski zgodovini je dinastija Juan sledila dinastiji Song in bila predhodnica dinastije Ming.

source.title: Yuan dynasty
paragraphs: The Yuan dynasty, officially the Great Yuan, was a Mongol-led imperial dynasty of China and a successor state to the Mongol Empire after its division. It was established by Kublai (Emperor Shizu or Setsen Khan), the fifth khagan-emperor of the Mongol Empire from the Borjigin clan, and lasted from 1271 to 1368 CE. In Chinese history, the Yuan dynasty followed the Song dynasty and preceded the Ming dynasty.

Yuezhi.headline: Jüedžiji
paragraphs: Jüedžiji so bili starodavno ljudstvo, ki ga kitajske kronike v 1. tisočletju pr. n. št. prvič opisujejo kot nomadske pastirje na sušnem travnatem območju v zahodnem delu današnje kitajske province Gansu. Po hudem porazu proti ljudstvu Šiungnu leta 176 pr. n. št. so se razdelili v dve skupini, ki sta se selili v različne smeri: Velike Jüedžije in Male Jüedžije. S tem se je začel zapleten domino učinek, ki se je širil na vse strani in za stoletja zaznamoval zgodovino velikega dela Azije.

source.title: Yuezhi
paragraphs: The Yuezhi were an ancient people first described in Chinese histories as nomadic pastoralists living in an arid grassland area in the western part of the modern Chinese province of Gansu, during the 1st millennium BC. After a major defeat at the hands of the Xiongnu in 176 BC, the Yuezhi split into two groups migrating in different directions: the Greater Yuezhi and Lesser Yuezhi. This started a complex domino effect that radiated in all directions and, in the process, set the course of history for much of Asia for centuries to come.
